title: Senior Google Ads Media Buyer (UK Fashion E-commerce dropshipping) — Shopping/PMax + Merchant Center (Profit First)
description:
We are building a UK-based general fashion e-commerce store (dropshipping model) and we’re looking for a senior Google Ads media buyer who can take us from 0 ? stable profitable days with a disciplined, profit-first approach.



This is NOT an entry-level role. We only want someone with a real, proven track record running Google Ads for e-commerce.



Our current stage (important context)

- UK market, general fashion store (broad catalog)

- Shopify (dropshipping)

- We are expanding the catalog in a controlled way to keep things healthy/compliant:

- 25 products/day until ~500–600 products

- Then we switch to 50 products/week (batch uploads)

- We need someone who understands how catalog growth impacts Merchant Center + Shopping/PMax performance and can manage this properly.



Your mission

Build and manage a Google Ads system that becomes consistently profitable and scalable, while keeping waste low and compliance strong.



Responsibilities

- Audit & fix: Google Ads account structure, tracking, Merchant Center/feed health

- Launch + manage: Shopping / Performance Max / Search (only what makes sense)

- Feed optimization: titles, attributes, product types, disapprovals, diagnostics

- Profit-first optimization: reduce wasted spend, improve CVR/CPA/ROAS, search term control

- Weekly reporting (clear & concise) + action plan



Hard requirements (do not apply if you can’t prove these)

- 3+ years hands-on Google Ads for e-commerce

- Strong experience with Shopping + Performance Max + Merchant Center

- Experience with dropshipping / tight margins

- Ability to work independently and make smart decisions with limited budget

- You MUST show proof: screenshots/case studies with metrics (redact sensitive info)



Payment terms (non-negotiable)

- We pay monthly only, at the end of the month

- Compensation options:

1. Fixed monthly retainer (agreed upfront), OR

2. 10% of ad spend (paid end of month)



If you cannot accept monthly end-of-month payment, please do not apply.



How to apply (required)

Include ALL of the following:

1. Short intro (2–5 lines)

2. 2–3 proof examples (store type, market, spend range, results, timeframe)

3. Your first 14-day plan for a UK general fashion store while the catalog is growing

4. Your preferred compensation option (retainer or 10% of ad spend)

5. Confirm you accept monthly end-of-month payment



IMPORTANT FILTER

To prove you read everything, start your application with this exact phrase:

“BLUEBERRY CHECK — Fully Read.”

Applications without this will be ignored.

title: Shopify & Google Merchant Center Specialist for Suspension, Misrepresentation & Feed Fixes
description:
We are looking for a serious, detail-focused, technically strong specialist who has real experience with Shopify and Google Merchant Center, especially with:



* GMC misrepresentation / suspension / website needs improvement issues

* Shopify store reviews for policy, trust, compliance, and technical consistency

* Feed errors, product disapprovals, attribute issues, sync issues

We need someone who can think deeply, work carefully, and get real quality out of their hours.



Our store is already live and we are actively trying to get the cleanest possible Google Merchant Center setup and approval path. We need someone who can help us review, fix, and improve everything properly so the store is as safe, compliant, and stable as possible for Google.



What you will work on

Your role will include work such as:



* reviewing our Shopify store for GMC-related risk points

* checking our Google Merchant Center thoroughly

* reviewing a detailed GMC checklist point by point

* identifying anything that is:



* incomplete

* inconsistent

* risky

* misleading

* fixing issues in:



* product data

* attributes

* feed setup

* sync issues

* policy pages

* trust signals

* business information consistency

* landing page consistency

* Shopify settings / theme output where relevant

* reviewing how products, attributes, and website pages align between:



* Shopify

* feed app(s)

* Google Merchant Center

* helping us make the store as GMC-safe and approval-ready as possible



Important

We are not looking for someone who only writes reports, gives generic advice, or repeats policy help pages.



We want someone who can:



* review deeply

* find real issues

* explain clearly

* implement fixes

* work with urgency and quality



If you are someone who only checks things superficially, this is not the right role.



What we are specifically looking for

You should ideally have strong experience with:



Shopify



* product setup

* collections

* navigation

* policy pages

* theme settings

* product pages

* app interactions

* store trust / UX review

* fixing inconsistencies

* diagnostics and issue checking

Feed / product data / sync



* attribute mapping

* apparel requirements

* availability / inventory sync

* pricing consistency

* feed-to-landing-page consistency

* issues caused by product pushes / imports / updates



GMC checklist / compliance mindset

You must be comfortable going through a detailed checklist and checking everything carefully and one by one, not loosely.



The type of person we want

We are looking for someone who is:



* highly detail-oriented

* careful and precise

* honest and direct

* technically capable

* proactive

* strong in communication

* responsive

* able to work independently

* able to explain what is wrong, what was fixed, and what still needs work

Daily work expectations

You must be willing to:

Final note

help us review and improve the store and GMC setup properly, thoroughly, and with real quality.

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Advanced Credit Repair Dispute Specialist
description:
We are not looking for basic credit repair specialists.



We are looking for someone who understands advanced dispute strategy, consumer law, and how to produce real, measurable results — not just send templates.



This role is for someone who knows how to get deletions, think strategically across dispute rounds, and move fast while maintaining accuracy.



If you rely on generic templates or surface-level disputes, this is not the role for you.



What You’ll Be Doing



* Managing client credit profiles and executing dispute rounds

* Disputing directly through credit bureau portals (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion)

* Filing and managing CFPB complaints and escalations

* Using advanced dispute strategies (FCRA, FDCPA, Metro 2, factual disputes, etc.)

* Handling all account types including:

    * Collections

    * Charge-offs

    * Late payments

    * Repossessions

    * Inquiries

    * Bankruptcies

    * Closed and open accounts

* Running credit sweep strategies when appropriate

* Updating client progress and maintaining clean, accurate records

* Working within our internal systems (GHL + DisputeFox workflows)



What We’re Looking For



* Strong understanding of FCRA, FDCPA, and consumer law

* Proven experience disputing through bureau portals and CFPB

* Proven success with both credit sweep strategies and advanced dispute strategies (this is required)

* Ability to handle all account types and structure disputes accordingly

* Familiarity with DisputeFox

* Ability to produce fast, clean, and permanent deletions

* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage volume

* Self-starter who can operate without constant oversight



Compensation



* Base pay is based on experience

* Performance-based increases tied to results and volume handled

* Opportunity to grow into full time and higher pay as you demonstrate consistent performance



We are building a long-term team. The more value you bring and the more volume you can handle efficiently, the more you will earn.



To Apply (Required)



Please answer the following:



1. What credit sweep strategies have you successfully used?

2. What advanced dispute strategies do you use beyond basic disputes?

3.. What tools/software have you used (DisputeFox, CRC, etc.)?

Additional Notes



Experience with DisputeFox, Metro 2 compliance, CFPB escalation, and litigation-based dispute strategies is a strong plus.



This role is for someone who takes pride in results, moves with urgency, and wants to grow with a serious operation.

title: Instagram Direct Message (DM) Manager- Numerology / Coaching Brand (English Fluent, US Audience)
description:
The Leelu Method is a fast-growing numerology compatibility coaching brand with 100,000+ followers on our verified Instagram 
 viral Reels regularly reach 7-23 MILLION views, and we help English-speaking women across the US, UK, and Australia decode their relationships using our proprietary numerological system.



This is NOT generic numerology — we use proprietary formulas based on forensic behavioral science, tested on 11,500+ profiles in corporate settings. 



Our founder, Lily Chystofat, is an established relationship expert.



We have a complete sales funnel in place: free compatibility quiz, free heartbreak protocol, free masterclass, $3.33 compatibility report, $697 core program, $1,700 guided track, and $4,997 VIP 1-on-1 coaching.



We're hiring TWO Instagram DM Managers to help us convert the massive incoming DM volume from our viral content into qualified leads and sales.



What You'll Do



Our ManyChat bot handles the first automated message when users type keywords like "MATCH" or "HEAL" in our Instagram DMs. YOUR job begins after the bot's message:



• Continue the conversation personally once the user replies to the automated message

• Give short, valuable numerology insights based on birth dates they share (we'll train you on our system over 2 weeks)

• Guide users toward the right product: free quiz, $3.33 compatibility report, free masterclass, $697 program, or 1-on-1 VIP consult

• Log every conversation in our CRM (Google Sheets)

• Nurture warm leads with follow-up messages over 3-14 days

• Escalate hot leads (VIP/coaching inquiries) to Lily directly

• Handle skeptics, objections, and emotionally-charged conversations with empathy and professionalism

• Meet our response-time standards: under 15 minutes during peak hours, under 1 hour otherwise



This is NOT a sales-pushy role. Our approach is educational, warm, and authoritative. Think "knowledgeable friend giving you a heads-up" — not "used car salesman."



???? Volume Expectations



•
DM conversations per day (normal volume)

• Peak days after viral Reels:
+ conversations

• 25-30 hours per week per manager

• Shifts cover different US time zones (we're hiring one early shift, one late shift)



???? Who We're Looking For



REQUIRED:

? Near-native written English (our audience is US/UK/AU — zero grammar mistakes)

? 2+ years of social media DM management, customer service, or similar client-facing work

? High emotional intelligence — our audience writes about breakups, infidelity, divorce, and loneliness. You must be able to hold space with warmth and without being clinical or pushy.

? Reliable daily availability (consistency is non-negotiable)

? Fast learner — our numerology system takes about 2 weeks of training to grasp the basics

? Comfortable with sales conversations, but in a consultative (not pushy) way

? Google Sheets proficiency for CRM tracking

? Stable internet and reliable work setup



PREFERRED (nice to have, not required):

? Experience in coaching, spiritual, dating, or relationship niches

? Basic numerology, astrology, or personal development knowledge

? ManyChat or similar chatbot platform experience

? Sales funnel understanding

? Previous work with US/UK-based clients



NOT A FIT IF:

? You copy-paste template replies without personalization

? You use pushy "BUY NOW!!!" sales language

? You're judgmental about women's relationship choices or lifestyles

? Your written English has grammar or clarity issues

? You need constant supervision — we need self-starters



We are hiring TWO managers to cover US time zones. Please specify your preferred shift in your application:



• SHIFT A: 9:00 PM - 5:00 AM Philippines Time (= 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM US Eastern)

• SHIFT B: 1:00 AM - 9:00 AM Philippines Time (= 1:00 PM - 9:00 PM US Eastern)



Weekend coverage: alternating weekends between the two managers.



???? How to Apply



Applications without ALL of the following will be ignored:



1) Your full name, timezone, and preferred shift (A or B)



2) A 3-5 sentence intro about yourself — written in the tone you would use when responding to a customer DM



3) Your relevant experience (DM management, customer service, coaching industry, or sales)



4) Complete this TEST SCENARIO:



A woman sends us this DM:



"I'm born on March 12. My husband is August 4. We've been married 11 years but something feels off lately. Is it him or me?"



Our automated bot has already sent her the free quiz link. She opened it but didn't complete it. She's now writing to you directly.



Write YOUR reply (2-3 messages max), showing how you would:

- Validate her feelings first

- Give her a small, intriguing insight (even made-up based on general numerology knowledge — we'll train you on our actual system)

- Move her toward either the $3.33 Compatibility Report OR the free masterclass



DO NOT write things like: "Please take the quiz first" or "Buy the report now!"



DO write: something warm, authoritative, and insightful that makes her feel seen.



5) Your expected monthly rate



6) How many hours per week you can commit to



7) Your start date availability



---



We will review all applications within 72 hours. Qualified candidates will be invited to a 15-minute video interview. The role begins with 2 weeks of paid training — we invest in our team from day one.

title: Legal Billing Assistant
description:
Job Type: Full-time



Working Hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time (U.S.), Monday through Friday





We are a busy U.S.-based family law firm seeking a Legal Billing Specialist to own our billing, trust accounting, and collections operations. This position requires strong organizational skills, excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to manage sensitive client billing conversations while partnering with attorneys to keep billing accurate and on schedule.

This role is best suited for someone who is highly detail-oriented, professional on the phone, and capable of managing multiple matters and deadlines in a fast-paced legal environment.

REQUIREMENTS (MANDATORY - NO EXCEPTIONS)

Applicants must meet ALL of the following:



Fluent spoken and written English with a clear American accent

Strong grammar and writing proficiency

Minimum 2 years of legal billing experience, preferably in family law or a similarly complex practice area

Strong understanding of IOLTA trust accounting rules and compliance requirements

Strong Microsoft Excel proficiency, including formulas, pivot tables, and reconciliation work (this will be tested)

Working knowledge of basic accounting and bookkeeping principles such as debits and credits, accounts receivable, and account reconciliation

Experience using legal practice management software such as MyCase, Clio, or Lawmatics

Proficiency managing WIP, invoicing, trust fund applications, and billing reports

Ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



Computer with at least 8GB RAM (16GB preferred)

Stable internet connection (minimum 100 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload) with backup internet access in case of outages

USB headset with clear microphone, since this role handles daily client calls

Dual monitor setup preferred for cross-referencing time entries, invoices, and reports

Quiet, distraction-free home office

Availability to work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time (U.S.)



Applicants who do not meet these requirements will not be considered.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Trust and Retainer Management



Monitor client trust balances daily and flag accounts below the minimum retainer threshold

Send timely replenishment requests and follow up to ensure funds are received before work continues

Apply trust funds correctly and maintain IOLTA compliance at all times

Maintain accurate records of all trust transactions and payment activity



Billing and Invoicing



Review and audit attorney and paralegal time entries for accuracy and completeness before billing

Generate pre-bills, final invoices, and monthly review letters

Ensure billing descriptions clearly communicate the value of work performed

Manage work-in-progress and coordinate with attorneys on billing cycles

Run billing reports and provide regular summaries to management



Collections and AR Management



Follow up on past-due balances in a professional and non-confrontational manner

Set up and monitor client payment plans and escalate accounts that are not progressing

Partner with attorneys on client calls when billing issues require legal explanation

Initiate disengagement processes when appropriate and directed

Maintain accurate accounts receivable records and prepare write-off requests for management approval



Client Communication



Handle a minimum of 10 client calls daily (collections, billing inquiries, new client setup)

Communicate clearly regarding balances, statements, and payment options

Respond promptly and professionally, de-escalating concerns when needed

Ensure alignment with the legal team on all billing communications



System and Process Support



Maintain and update client billing records in the firm's practice management software

Assist in identifying and implementing process improvements to billing workflows

Support onboarding of new clients by setting up billing profiles and retainer agreements



PREFERRED



Collections and payment plan management experience in a legal setting

Familiarity with U.S. family law billing practices, retainer structures, and court fee schedules



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS!!!

Interested applicants must send a GOOGLE DRIVE link containing the following:



Your updated resume

A 1-2 minute VIDEO recording introducing yourself, demonstrating your spoken English, and explaining why you are a good fit for the role (set to "Anyone with the link can view")

A short written paragraph (3-5 sentences) explaining your relevant legal billing and trust accounting experience



Include the codeword "milo45" in your
 subject line or in the first sentence of your application so we know you read the full job post.

Applications that do not include all required materials will not be considered.

title: Client Advisor / Crisis Response Coordinator (US Hours) (MALE)
description:
We are hiring 3 Client Advisors / Crisis Response Coordinators to join our remote team. (Please send a 60-second English voice recording introducing yourself, explaining why you are a strong fit, and summarizing your phone-based sales or client support experience.)



This role has a sales component, but it is not an aggressive sales role. You will not be pushing a product to random leads. Your job is to respond quickly to inbound inquiries, calm the client when needed, understand the urgency of the case, explain how the service works, recommend the right service package, and guide the client through agreement, payment, onboarding, and handoff to our operations team.



We are looking for candidates with a mature, steady, confident phone presence. The right person should sound calm under pressure, communicate clearly with US-based clients, and handle sensitive conversations professionally.

- Respond to inbound leads through phone, SMS, WhatsApp,
, and messaging platforms within minutes.

- Conduct first consultations by listening to the client’s situation, assessing urgency, and recommending the most suitable service package.

- Explain the services, pricing, onboarding steps, contracts, and expectations clearly.

- Guide clients through the agreement, payment, and onboarding process.

- Coordinate with the operations team after the client signs up to ensure a smooth case handoff.

- Follow up with clients at key milestones, including after 24 hours, weekly updates, and service completion.

- Maintain accurate records in our dashboard, including lead status, call notes, messages, contracts, and follow-up tasks.

- Collect client feedback and reviews after successful service completion.

- Clear spoken English and the ability to communicate confidently with US-based clients.

- Calm, mature, and professional phone manner.

- Strong empathy and emotional control when speaking with distressed clients.

- Experience handling objections, pricing conversations, and follow-ups.

- Strong reliability. Late starts and no-shows directly affect client response times.

- Fast and stable internet connection.

title: Deal Origination Analyst
description:
Here's the job post:



Origination Analyst — Full-Time, Remote

About Us

Guidesource is a UK-based executive search and financial advisory firm that helps private equity investors, corporates, and family offices identify high-quality investment opportunities and senior executive talent. We work across sectors including healthcare, dental, childcare, education, and professional services, supporting acquisitive corporates and PE-backed consolidators with bespoke buy-side origination mandates.

The Role

We're looking for a sharp, commercially-minded Origination Analyst to join our team full-time. You'll be at the core of our buy-side delivery — using our suite of market intelligence platforms to identify viable acquisition targets, filter and qualify opportunities against detailed client criteria, and build tiered target lists that drive real M&A outcomes.

This is a research-led role with a strong commercial edge. You'll need to think like an investor: understanding what makes a business attractive, how to read financials at a glance, and how to spot the right targets within a fragmented market.

Key Responsibilities



Use platforms such as Inven, Valu8, Sourcescrub, Pitchbook, Companies House, and similar tools to identify acquisition targets aligned with client mandates.

Filter and qualify long lists into tiered target shortlists using bespoke scoring criteria (size, geography, ownership, financial profile, strategic fit).

Analyse company financials (revenue, EBITDA, growth, margins) to assess viability and prioritise outreach.

Conduct deep-dive research on individual targets — ownership structure, key personnel, recent activity, competitive positioning.

Build and maintain structured target databases and pipeline trackers.

Work closely with the leadership team to refine targeting criteria and improve list quality across mandates.

Support the wider origination workflow including market mapping, sector deep-dives, and client-ready deliverables.



What We're Looking For



Prior experience in M&A, corporate finance, private equity, consulting, or buy-side origination is strongly preferred.

Strong financial acumen — comfortable interpreting accounts, reading P&Ls, and assessing company performance.

Commercial instincts — able to look at a business and form a view on whether it's a credible acquisition target.

Hands-on experience with deal sourcing platforms (Inven, Valu8, Sourcescrub, Pitchbook, Capital IQ, or similar).

Strong research and data-handling skills, with a high bar for accuracy and structured thinking.

Excellent written English and the ability to communicate findings clearly.

Self-starter mentality — able to manage multiple mandates and work independently in a remote setting.

Sector experience in healthcare, professional services, or fragmented owner-operator markets is a plus.



Benefits & Details



100% remote role (UK business hours preferred).

Full-time position.

Competitive pay based on experience.

Long-term role with strong potential to grow into a senior origination role as the business scales.



How to Apply

Please send:



A short intro message explaining your relevant experience, including any M&A, corporate finance, or origination work.

Examples of previous origination projects, target lists, or market maps you've worked on (anonymised is fine).

The deal sourcing platforms you've used and your level of fluency with each.

Your availability and monthly rate expectations.

description:
Video Editor (& Graphic Designer) - Direct Response Meta Ads



Hey there! I am Hunor, an E-commerce brand-owner based in Hungary.



Me and my team are on the hunt for a highly-skilled Video Editor to join our team. Your mission? To create killer ads to scale our Shopify brand to multiple 7 & 8-figures.





Job Qualifier :



Important! As much as we love growth & development, if you do NOT have direct experience in editing direct-response video ads and image ads for Meta/TikTok, this role is not for you… But if you do ????





Our Brand:



Futurax Health is a rapidly growing health brand selling wellness and pain-relief products. As we are scaling fast, we are looking for an expert video editor to keep up with the volume of new creatives we need to publish each week.

We have two golden rules for all of our tea
mbers:

2. You need to be TRUSTWORTY. - We don't tolerate laziness and constant overdues for projects and deadlines. As we are a really fast-growing brand that needs new creatives every day, we can't afford to lose 
ntum.

The purpose of the Video Editor / Graphic Designer Role is to edit video and static ads by executing project briefs. Our main focus is direct-response D2C (direct-to-customer) ads. What does this mean? This means that you will need to master two things in your edits:

We hold our tea
mbers to the highest standards and reward stellar work. Expect your rates to rise rapidly as you excel. Ready to join us? Here's our hiring process:

Time Zone / Hours: [9:00 AM to 5:00 PM] Central Time (U.S.)



We are a busy U.S.-based family law firm seeking a licensed Filipino lawyer to support our attorneys with substantive legal work. This is a remote, behind-the-scenes legal support role focused on research, drafting, and case preparation. It is best suited for a strong legal writer who is highly detail-oriented and able to manage multiple matters and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

About This Role

This is a legal support position, not a U.S. attorney role. You will not practice U.S. law, give legal advice to clients, or appear in court. You will work behind the scenes supporting our U.S.-licensed attorneys. Your legal training is essential to this work, which is why we require a licensed lawyer.

What You'll Do



Conduct legal research on U.S. and state-specific family law issues using resources we provide

Draft pleadings, motions, discovery requests and responses, declarations, and correspondence for attorney review

Review and summarize case documents, financial records, and discovery materials

Prepare case timelines, summaries, and memos

Help build and maintain document templates and internal legal workflows

Communicate with our attorneys to refine work product



Requirements (Mandatory, No Exceptions)

Applicants must meet ALL of the following. Do not apply if you do not meet every one of them.



Law degree and current admission to the Philippine Bar in good standing

Minimum 3 years of experience in legal practice, legal drafting, or legal research

Demonstrated legal writing experience, with samples you can share

Near-native written English. Your writing will be tested before hire

Clear American accent and strong spoken English

Prior experience supporting a U.S. law firm or doing U.S.-based legal work

Able to commit to a consistent full-time schedule with the required U.S. hours overlap

Seeking a long-term role, not short-term or freelance gap work

Able to complete a paid test project as part of the hiring process



Applicants who do not meet these requirements will not be considered.

Technical Requirements



Computer with at least 16GB RAM, able to run Microsoft Office and cloud-based legal practice management software smoothly

Stable internet connection with a minimum 50 Mbps download speed

Backup internet access (mobile data or a second connection) in case of outages

USB headset with a clear microphone

Working webcam for video calls

Backup power source (UPS or equivalent) to handle short outages

Quiet, distraction-free home office



Strongly Preferred



Family law experience specifically

Experience with legal practice management software such as Lawmatics, MyCase, or Clio

Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel)



How to Apply

Follow every step. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be read.



Include the codeword "milo47" in your
 subject line or in the first sentence of your application

Send a single Google Drive link with all of your application materials, with sharing set to "Anyone with the link can view." We will not chase you for access

Your Google Drive folder must include:



Your updated resume

Samples of your legal work (redacted briefs, motions, or memos)

A 1 to 2 minute video introducing yourself, demonstrating your spoken English, and explaining why you believe you are qualified for this role





In your reply, include a short paragraph (3 to 5 sentences) describing your legal background, years of experience, and any U.S. or family law experience

Confirm your Philippine Bar admission year and current status



Applications that do not include all required materials will not be considered.

title: HubSpot CRM Administrator
description:
We're looking for a HubSpot CRM Administrator to own, optimize, and scale the HubSpot environment for a fast-growing national renovation and restoration contractor. The company recently migrated to HubSpot and needs someone who can take full ownership of day-to-day system management, data integrity, reporting, workflow automation, and end-user training.



This is a post-implementation role. The system has been built and now needs to be refined, maintained, and leveraged for insights and growth. If you have come from an agency background where you managed multiple HubSpot accounts and are ready to go deep on one, this role is a strong fit.



Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

- Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

- 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

- Full ownership of the HubSpot environment inside a growing national contractor

- Direct collaboration with the Director of Marketing and cross-functional teams



What You'll Work On



CRM System Management



- Own day-to-day management of the HubSpot CRM system

- Maintain and optimize properties, pipelines, objects, and workflows

- Ensure system structure aligns with evolving business needs

- Identify and implement process improvements proactively



Reporting and Dashboards



- Build and maintain dashboards and reports for leadership and internal teams

- Translate business questions into actionable CRM reporting

- Ensure data consistency and reliability for accurate reporting across functions



Data Quality and Governance



- Manage data imports, cleanup, and deduplication

- Maintain data hygiene and enforce best practices across teams

- Audit and troubleshoot data discrepancies

- Partner with team leads to ensure consistent data entry and process adherence



Workflow Automation



- Create and optimize automation workflows

- Monitor workflow performance and troubleshoot issues

- Ensure all automated processes are efficient, scalable, and well-documented



End-User Training and Support



- Serve as the primary point of contact for all HubSpot users

- Train and support internal teams on CRM usage and best practices

- Document processes and maintain an internal knowledge base

- Present data and training materials clearly to non-technical stakeholders



What You Bring



- 3+ years of experience administering HubSpot CRM

- Strong experience building HubSpot reports and dashboards

- Hands-on experience with data migrations, imports, and cleanup

- Experience building and maintaining workflows and automation in HubSpot

- Strong understanding of CRM data structure and lifecycle management

- Comfortable presenting and training non-technical end users

- Ability to translate business needs into CRM solutions independently

- Experience in RevOps, Sales Ops, or Marketing Ops preferred

- Familiarity with CRM integrations and APIs



Nice to Have



- HubSpot certifications

- Background working at a HubSpot implementation or marketing agency

- Experience supporting CRM transitions or migrations from other platforms

- Familiarity with the construction, real estate, or property management industry



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your updated resume

2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, walking through a HubSpot workflow or dashboard you built, and describing how you have trained or supported end users in a previous role



Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.



If you are a hands-on HubSpot administrator who can own a CRM environment end to end, keep data clean, build workflows that actually work, and train a team that is still learning the system, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work.

title: Video Editor for Social Media, Ads, & Marketing Content
description:
Caliber is a U.S.-based marketing and growth firm serving local service businesses, professional services companies, B2B brands, and growing companies across multiple industries. We are looking for a skilled Video Editor to help create social media videos, short-form clips, commercials, testimonial edits, webinar/podcast cutdowns, and marketing videos across multiple client accounts.



This is not just a basic video clipping role. We need someone who understands social-first video, hook-first editing, clean pacing, captions, brand consistency, and platform-specific formatting.



You will work with our copywriters, designers, social media managers, and marketing strategists to turn raw footage, interviews, podcasts, webinars, testimonials, screen recordings, and client videos into polished content for LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
, ads, websites, and
 campaigns.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN:



VIDEO EDITING & PRODUCTION

 • Editing raw footage into polished final cuts.

 • Editing talking-head videos, interviews, testimonials, webinars, podcasts, screen recordings, and client footage.

 • Cleaning up awkward pauses, filler words, and rough cuts when needed.

 • Jump cut editing for fast-paced social content.

 • Pacing and rhythm editing to match the brand, platform, and audience.

 • Basic color correction and color grading.

 • Basic audio cleanup, noise reduction, and volume leveling.

 • Adding music, sound effects, and audio transitions when appropriate.

 • Adding simple B-roll from provided footage or stock libraries when needed.

 • Creating clean, professional edits for both local service businesses and professional brands.



SHORT-FORM & SOCIAL VIDEO

 • Creating Instagram Reels.

 • Creating TikTok videos.

 • Creating YouTube Shorts.

 • Creating LinkedIn video clips.

 • Creating
 video posts and Reels.

 • Creating
/X video clips when needed.

 • Cutting long-form content into short-form clips.

 • Identifying strong soundbites and 
nts from longer videos.

 • Creating vertical, square, and horizontal exports based on platform specs.

 • Creating 15-second, 30-second, 60-second, and 90-second edits.

 • Creating hook-first edits that capture attention quickly.

 • Formatting videos for LinkedIn, Reels, Shorts, TikTok,
, and ads.



COMMERCIAL & AD VIDEO EDITING

 • Editing short commercials.

 • Editing paid social video ads for Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, Google, and other platforms.

 • Creating product or service promo videos.

 • Creating local business promotional videos.

 • Creating offer-based video ads.

 • Creating founder-led or spokesperson-style ad edits.

 • Creating testimonial ad edits.

 • Creating before-and-after style videos when applicable.

 • Creating event promo videos.

 • Creating launch videos.

 • Creating multiple ad variants from one source video, including different hooks, lengths, CTAs, and formats.

 • Editing retargeting video clips.



TESTIMONIAL & SOCIAL PROOF VIDEOS

 • Editing customer testimonial videos.

 • Editing client interview clips.

 • Editing review-based videos.

 • Editing case study video snippets.

 • Creating social proof highlight reels.

 • Pulling the strongest quotes from longer recordings.

 • Adding captions, quote emphasis, speaker labels, and branded frames.

 • Creating clean, professional testimonial edits that feel credible and polished.



PODCAST, WEBINAR & LONG-FORM REPURPOSING

 • Editing podcast clips.

 • Editing webinar clips.

 • Editing video call clips.

 • Editing Loom or screen recording clips.

 • Editing guest interview clips.

 • Cleaning up webinar recordings when needed.

 • Creating highlight reels from longer recordings.

 • Pulling 5-10 short clips from longer videos when needed.

 • Adding intro/outro sequences, music beds, chapter markers, or title cards when needed.

 • Repurposing one long video into multiple short-form social clips.



CAPTIONS & SUBTITLES

 • Adding burned-in captions for social videos.

 • Creating styled captions that match brand guidelines.

 • Cleaning up auto-generated captions for accuracy.

 • Making captions readable, properly timed, and visually clean.

 • Using caption tools such as CapCut, Descript, Premiere Pro, Kapwing, or similar tools.

 • Supporting subtitle formatting when needed.

 • Ensuring names, titles, brands, and important terms are spelled correctly.



MOTION GRAPHICS & VISUAL ELEMENTS

 • Adding lower thirds, including names, titles, locations, and company names.

 • Adding title cards.

 • Adding intro and outro sequences.

 • Adding animated text overlays.

 • Adding simple kinetic typography when needed.

 • Adding call-to-action overlays and end screens.

 • Adding logo placements and branded frames.

 • Adding progress bars, countdown timers, or visual accents when appropriate.

 • Adding simple transitions and motion elements.

 • Using graphics provided by the designer when needed.

 • Creating simple motion graphics when within your skill set.



BRANDED VIDEO SYSTEMS

 • Following client brand guidelines.

 • Using correct logos, colors, fonts, and visual styles.

 • Creating consistent caption styles per client.

 • Creating consistent lower-third styles per client.

 • Creating reusable video templates when appropriate.

 • Collaborating with the designer on branded frames, intros, outros, thumbnails, title cards, and motion graphics assets.

 • Maintaining visual consistency across video content for each client.



THUMBNAILS & VIDEO COVERS

 • Creating or supporting thumbnails for social videos.

 • Creating YouTube thumbnail drafts when needed.

 • Creating LinkedIn video cover images.

 • Creating Reel/TikTok/Shorts cover frames when needed.

 • Collaborating with the designer when more polished thumbnail design is needed.



FILE MANAGEMENT & DELIVERY

 • Organizing raw footage and project files by client.

 • Naming files clearly.

 • Exporting in the correct format and size for each platform.

 • Exporting vertical, square, horizontal, and ad-ready versions when needed.

 • Maintaining draft and revision versions.

 • Delivering final files through Google Drive, Dropbox, 
, or similar tools.

 • Keeping editable project files organized.

 • Maintaining a video asset library per client when needed.

 • Tracking revisions and file status clearly.



COLLABORATION

 • Work from creative briefs provided by the copywriter, strategist, or social media manager.

 • Coordinate with the designer on brand look, lower thirds, captions, colors, fonts, title cards, thumbnails, and intro/outro graphics.

 • Coordinate with the social media manager on platform specs, publishing dates, video lengths, captions, and file delivery.

 • Coordinate with the copywriter on hooks, scripts, voiceover copy, caption copy, and testimonial quote selections.

 • Flag poor footage, bad audio, missing assets, unclear instructions, or quality issues early.

 • Communicate clearly about timelines, blockers, and revisions.



STRATEGY SUPPORT

 • Recommend which raw footage 
nts are strongest for social clips.

 • Suggest content formats based on platform trends.

 • Identify repurposing opportunities from existing video libraries.

 • Suggest different hooks, cutdowns, and formats from the same source footage.

 • Stay current on social video editing styles, platform formats, and short-form video best practices.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

 • Strong experience editing social media videos.

 • Strong experience creating short-form clips for Reels, TikTok, Shorts, LinkedIn, and
.

 • Experience editing captioned videos.

 • Experience editing testimonial videos, podcast clips, webinar clips, or interview clips.

 • Experience editing commercial, promotional, or ad-style videos.

 • Strong sense of pacing, hooks, rhythm, and retention.

 • Strong attention to detail.

 • Able to match different brand styles across multiple clients.

 • Able to work from creative briefs and brand guidelines.

 • Able to organize files and manage revisions.

 • Able to communicate clearly and meet deadlines.

 • Comfortable managing multiple client projects at once.

 • Responsive, reliable, and self-directed.

 • Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions quickly.



TOOLS YOU SHOULD KNOW:

 • Adobe Premiere Pro, strongly preferred.

 • CapCut.

 • Descript.

 • DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing tools.

 • Canva or Figma for receiving design assets.

 • Google Drive or Dropbox for file delivery.



NICE TO HAVE:

 • After Effects experience.

 • Motion graphics experience.

 • Kinetic typography experience.

 • Logo animation experience.

 • Advanced caption styling experience.

 • 
 experience.

 • Riverside, OpusClip, or podcast/webinar clipping tool experience.

 • YouTube editing experience.

 • Full podcast episode editing experience.

 • Full webinar editing experience.

 • Stock B-roll sourcing experience.

 • Music licensing experience.

 • Experience editing videos for local service businesses, professional services, real estate, mortgage, legal, healthcare, home services, SaaS, B2B, or technology companies.

 • Experience working inside a marketing agency.

 • Basic understanding of paid social video ads.



ROLE BOUNDARIES:

 • Filming or videography will usually come from the client, Caliber, or another tea
mber.

 • Graphic design beyond basic overlays will usually be handled by the designer.

 • Scriptwriting and long-form copy will usually come from the copywriter.

 • Social media scheduling will usually be handled by the social media manager.

 • Final content strategy will usually come from Caliber leadership.

 • Paid ads management will usually be handled separately.

 • Client-facing strategy calls will usually go through Caliber leadership.



WHAT TO EXPECT WEEKLY:

Depending on client needs, you may work on:

 • Short-form social clips.

 • Captioned videos.

 • Testimonial edits.

 • Commercial or ad-style edits.

 • Podcast, webinar, or interview clips.

 • LinkedIn, Reels, TikTok, Shorts, and
 
.

 • Video thumbnails or cover frames.

 • Branded intro/outro or lower-third updates.

 • Multiple cutdowns from one longer video.

 • Revisions based on feedback.

 • Exporting and organizing platform-specific files.

 • Collaboration with the designer, social media manager, and copywriter.



PAID TEST:

Finalists may be asked to complete a short paid test:

 • Edit one short-form video from provided raw footage.

 • Add captions.

 • Add basic branded styling.

 • Create a strong hook in the first few seconds.

 • Export the video in a social-ready format.

 • Send a short note explaining your editing choices.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY:

This role has strong potential to grow into more hours as Caliber expands. We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who wants to grow with us, not a one-off contractor.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please include:

 • A short introduction about your video editing experience.

 • 3-5 examples of social videos, ads, testimonials, podcast clips, webinar clips, or short-form videos you have edited.

 • The editing tools you use regularly.

 • Your experience with captions, short-form social clips, testimonial edits, and ad-style videos.

 • Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

 • Write “Caliber Video” at the top of your application so we know you read this post carefully.

title: Video Editor for Engaging Meta Ads | Long-term Role
description:

We’re looking for a Video Editor to join our fast-growing brand and help us craft compelling videos for Meta & TikTok ads. If you have an eye for storytelling, pacing, and the latest trends, this role is for you.



No freelancers! In this role the editor will be fully attached to our company and no other companies.



About the Role

As our Video Editor, you’ll be responsible for:



Editing engaging short-form videos – Cutting, enhancing, and optimizing content for Instagram and
 ads.

Optimizing for performance – Creating videos that capture attention quickly and drive engagement and sales.

Adding dynamic effects – Using transitions, text animations, and sound to make content stand out.

Keeping up with trends – Staying updated on what works in fashion and e-commerce content.

This is a long-term role with growth opportunities. We need someone who understands how to create videos that perform well and align with our brand identity.

Proven experience in video editing – A strong portfolio of short-form videos for social media and ads.

Understanding of social media & ad content – Ability to create high-performing videos for different platforms.

Expert in video editing software – Proficiency in Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, CapCut, or similar tools.

Strong storytelling skills – Ability to structure videos with compelling pacing and flow.

Branding awareness – Ability to align edits with our aesthetic and maintain brand consistency.

Commitment & availability – Must be long-term focused with no other brand commitments.

This is a part-time role with potential for full-time. Fully remote.



Why Join Us?

Be part of a fast-growing international fashion brand.

Work in a creative environment with opportunities to make an impact.

Long-term career growth and stable work.

Competitive pay for valuable tea
mbers.



How to Apply

If this sounds like you, send us:



Your portfolio – Examples of past video edits (Reels, TikTok, ads).

A message with the word ‘pineapple’ in the title so we know you read this post.

Your preferred editing software/tools.

title: Executive Assistant & Marketing Operations Coordinator
description:
Caliber is a U.S.-based marketing and growth firm serving local service businesses, professional services companies, B2B brands, and growing companies across multiple industries. We are looking for a highly organized Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator to support the founder across business operations, client coordination, marketing operations, billing/bookkeeping support, and personal administration.



This is a right-hand support role for a founder who manages multiple clients, contractors, projects, meetings, deadlines, and personal responsibilities. We need someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and able to bring structure to a fast-moving business.



This is not just a basic virtual assistant role. You will help keep the founder organized, keep client work moving, coordinate with tea
mbers, track deadlines, prepare notes and follow-ups, support billing and bookkeeping workflows, and assist with personal admin tasks when needed.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN:



EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT SUPPORT

 • Calendar management, including scheduling client calls, team check-ins, meetings, and personal appointments.

 • Rescheduling and confirming meetings when needed.

 • Protecting focus blocks and helping reduce calendar chaos.

 • Preparing daily and weekly agendas.

 • Sending reminders before important calls, deadlines, and tasks.

 •
 inbox management, including organizing, labeling, flagging priority
s, and drafting responses for review.

 • Following up on unanswered
s and outstanding communications.

 • Tracking open tasks, follow-ups, and commitments.

 • Managing the founder’s task list and daily priorities.

 • Taking meeting notes and distributing action items.

 • Turning messy notes, texts,
s, and Loom videos into organized action items.

 • Proofreading documents before they go to clients.

 • Researching tools, vendors, services, or options when needed.

 • Preparing weekly status reports or team updates.



CLIENT & ACCOUNT SUPPORT

 • Preparing agendas before client calls.

 • Pulling prior notes, links, context, and background information before client meetings.

 • Drafting client recap
s after calls.

 • Tracking action items from client meetings.

 • Tracking decisions, approvals, open questions, and next steps.

 • Maintaining a client tracker with status, next steps, renewal dates, outstanding items, and key notes.

 • Tracking what is waiting on the client, what is waiting on the team, and what is waiting on the founder.

 • Helping prepare weekly client status updates.

 • Flagging possible scope creep or unclear requests.

 • Drafting and formatting proposals, scopes of work, and client documents from direction.

 • Supporting client onboarding, including sending contracts, intake forms, welcome
s, and setting up new client folders.

 • Maintaining client folders, documents, briefs, assets, and notes.



MARKETING OPERATIONS SUPPORT

 • Helping manage campaign timelines and keep projects on track.

 • Maintaining project boards in ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Trello, or similar tools.

 • Tracking deliverables, deadlines, and owners across clients.

 • Tracking what has been delivered, what is pending, and what needs review.

 • Maintaining a master content calendar across clients when needed.

 • Coordinating asset handoffs between writers, designers, CRM specialists, social media managers, video editors, and web developers.

 • Following up with tea
mbers on outstanding tasks.

 • Tracking blockers and missing assets.

 • Formatting and organizing client reports before review.

 • Updating client-facing documents, decks, trackers, and reports.

 • Researching competitors, prospects, or client background information when needed.

 • Setting up and maintaining shared folders and file organization in Google Drive.

 • Helping create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and internal documentation.



BILLING, BOOKKEEPING & FINANCE ADMIN SUPPORT

 • Preparing and sending invoice drafts on schedule.

 • Tracking sent invoices and payment status.

 • Following up on unpaid invoices when approved.

 • Maintaining a simple income and expense tracker.

 • Tracking payments received and outstanding.

 • Reconciling payments against internal trackers when needed.

 • Organizing receipts and expense documentation.

 • Categorizing expenses in QuickBooks, FreshBooks, Wave, or spreadsheets.

 • Pulling monthly financial summaries for review.

 • Tracking client retainers, project budgets, and subcontractor costs.

 • Tracking contractor hours and payments.

 • Helping make sure contractors are paid correctly and on time.

 • Maintaining records for tax purposes.

 • Organizing bookkeeping files for the accountant/bookkeeper.

 • Coordinating with the accountant or bookkeeper when needed.



PERSONAL ASSISTANT SUPPORT

 • Managing personal calendar items, appointments, personal commitments, and reminders.

 • Scheduling personal appointments such as doctor, dentist, service providers, or household needs.

 • Travel planning, including researching flights, hotels, rental cars, restaurants, and building itineraries.

 • Personal research, including finding the best option for a purchase, service, vendor, or decision.

 • Tracking orders, returns, subscriptions, cancellations, confirmations, and reservations.

 • Organizing personal notes, checklists, and follow-ups.

 • Helping with miscellaneous personal admin tasks that can be handled remotely.

TEAM COORDINATION

 • Tracking blockers and missing assets.

 • Maintaining weekly team status updates.

 • Coordinating handoffs between the copywriter, designer, web developer, video editor, social media manager, and CRM specialist.

 • Making sure files, links, and deliverables are organized.

 • Helping ensure the right person knows what they need to do next.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

 • Excellent organization and attention to detail.

 • Strong written English.

 • Comfortable managing calendars, inboxes, tasks, follow-ups, and project trackers.

 • Comfortable coordinating across multiple clients and tea
mbers.

 • Comfortable with spreadsheets, trackers, and project management tools.

 • Able to take messy information and organize it clearly.

 • Proactive and able to flag issues before they become problems.

 • Trustworthy and professional.

 • Comfortable with confidential business and personal information.

 • Reliable, responsive, and self-directed.

 • Able to work with a fast-moving founder and changing priorities.

 • Google Calendar.

 • Google Docs.

 • Google Sheets.

 • Google Drive.

 • Slack.

 • Zoom or Google Meet.

 • ClickUp, Asana, Trello, Notion, or similar project management tools.

 • HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or CRM tools are a plus.



NICE TO HAVE:

 • Experience supporting a founder, CEO, agency owner, consultant, or executive.

 • Experience working with a marketing agency.

 • Experience with client coordination.

 • Experience with billing, invoicing, expense tracking, or bookkeeping support.

 • Experience with contractor coordination.

 • Experience with proposals, scopes of work, contracts, or onboarding documents.

 • Experience creating SOPs and internal documentation.

 • Experience managing both business and personal admin tasks.

 • Experience with travel planning, vendor research, or personal assistant tasks.



ROLE BOUNDARIES:

title: Paid Advertising, Paid Media, & Marketing Demand Generation Manager
description:
Caliber is a U.S.-based marketing and growth firm serving local service businesses, professional services companies, B2B brands, and growing companies across multiple industries. We are looking for a skilled Paid Media & Demand Generation Manager to help plan, launch, manage, optimize, and report on advertising campaigns across multiple client accounts.



This role is ideal for someone who understands paid acquisition, lead generation, campaign structure, conversion tracking, audience targeting, creative testing, budget pacing, landing page performance, and reporting.



This is not a “boost posts” role. We need someone who can manage real ad campaigns across platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads, and other PPC/social advertising channels. You should be comfortable owning campaign execution while collaborating with copywriters, designers, video editors, web developers, CRM specialists, and Caliber leadership.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN:



PAID SOCIAL

 • Meta Ads campaign setup, management, optimization, and reporting.

 •
 and Instagram ad campaigns.

 • LinkedIn Ads when applicable, including sponsored content, lead gen forms, retargeting, and website traffic campaigns.

 • TikTok Ads when applicable.

 • YouTube Ads when applicable.

 • Pinterest Ads or X/Twitter Ads when relevant.

 • Audience research and targeting strategy.

 • Custom audience and lookalike audience creation.

 • Retargeting campaign setup and management.

 • Pixel installation verification and troubleshooting.

 • A/B testing ad creative, copy, audiences, landing pages, and offers.

 • Ad creative briefs for designers and video editors.

 • Ad copy writing or coordination with the copywriter on ad copy variants.



PPC & SEARCH

 • Google Ads campaign setup, management, optimization, and reporting.

 • Google Search campaigns.

 • Google Display campaigns.

 • Google Performance Max campaigns when appropriate.

 • YouTube campaigns when appropriate.

 • Microsoft/Bing Ads when applicable.

 • Google Local Services Ads for local service clients when applicable.

 • Paid search keyword research.

 • Negative keyword management.

 • Ad group structure and campaign architecture.

 • Bid strategy management, including manual bidding, target CPA, maximize conversions, and target ROAS when applicable.

 • Quality Score optimization.

 • Ad extensions and assets, including sitelinks, callouts, structured snippets, call extensions, and lead forms.

 • Search term reviews and ongoing campaign cleanup.

 • Landing page recommendations for conversion improvement.



DEMAND GENERATION STRATEGY SUPPORT

 • Full-funnel campaign planning from awareness to conversion.

 • Lead generation campaign strategy per client.

 • Offer and angle testing.

 • Campaign calendar planning aligned with client goals.

 • Budget allocation recommendations across channels.

 • Seasonal campaign planning.

 • Competitor ad research and analysis.

 • Identifying new channel opportunities per client.

 • Recommending when to use search, paid social, retargeting, lead forms, landing pages, or awareness campaigns.



CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT & OPTIMIZATION

 • Daily or regular campaign monitoring depending on account size.

 • Weekly optimization of bids, budgets, audiences, placements, keywords, and creative.

 • Pausing underperforming ads and scaling winners.

 • Budget pacing to prevent over- or underspending.

 • Frequency monitoring and creative refresh recommendations.

 • Ad fatigue monitoring.

 • Campaign QA before launch, including settings, pixels, URLs, UTMs, forms, budgets, and tracking.

 • UTM parameter setup and management.

 • Landing page conversion rate monitoring.

 • Campaign naming conventions and account organization.

 • Documentation of major campaign changes and optimization decisions.



TRACKING & ANALYTICS

 • Google Analytics 4 setup and QA.

 • Google Tag Manager setup and QA.

 • Google Ads conversion tracking.

 • Meta Pixel setup and QA.

 • Meta Conversions API awareness or setup when applicable.

 • LinkedIn Insight Tag setup and QA.

 • TikTok Pixel setup when applicable.

 • UTM tracking across campaigns.

 • Basic attribution awareness.

 • Reporting on ROAS, CPA, CPL, CTR, CPC, CPM, impressions, reach, frequency, conversion rate, and lead quality where available.

 • Connecting ad performance to CRM data where possible.

 • Coordinating with the CRM specialist on lead quality, attribution, pipeline data, and source tracking.

 • Coordinating with the web developer on landing page tracking and conversion events.



REPORTING

 • Weekly performance snapshots per client.

 • Monthly campaign reports.

 • Clear summaries of what ran, what changed, what worked, what did not work, and what should happen next.

 • Dashboard builds in Google Looker Studio or similar tools when needed.

 • Budget pacing reports.

 • Lead quality and campaign performance summaries.

 • Competitive ad research summaries when tools allow.

 • Recommendations for budget increases, budget decreases, or reallocation based on performance.

 • Clear insights, not just screenshots.



CREATIVE COLLABORATION

 • Writing creative briefs for designers and video editors.

 • Specifying exact sizes, formats, platform specs, and variations needed for ad assets.

 • Reviewing ad creative before launch for compliance and effectiveness.

 • Requesting copy variants from the copywriter for testing.

 • Identifying winning creative elements to inform future production.

 • Recommending creative refreshes before performance drops.

 • Coordinating static ads, carousels, video ads, testimonial ads, display ads, and retargeting assets.



LANDING PAGE & FUNNEL OPTIMIZATION

 • Reviewing landing pages and recommending improvements.

 • Coordinating with the copywriter on headlines, CTAs, offer copy, and page messaging.

 • Coordinating with designers and web developers on layout, visual hierarchy, page speed, and conversion-focused changes.

 • Identifying landing page friction that may hurt conversion rates.

 • Recommending A/B tests for headlines, CTAs, forms, offers, and layouts.

 • Reviewing form length, mobile experience, page speed, and conversion flow.

 • Ensuring ad messaging and landing page messaging are aligned.



AD ACCOUNT & PLATFORM MANAGEMENT

 • Managing multiple client ad accounts.

 • Supporting Business Manager and ad account setup for new clients.

 • Managing account access and permissions when needed.

 • Monitoring ad account health.

 • Staying current on platform policy changes.

 • Helping avoid account flags, restrictions, and disapprovals.

 • Managing billing and payment method awareness per client account when needed.

 • Troubleshooting disapproved ads and platform issues.

 • Keeping accounts organized and documented.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

 • Hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads. Both are required.

 • Experience with LinkedIn Ads is strongly preferred.

 • Experience managing paid media for lead generation.

 • Strong understanding of campaign structure, targeting, budgets, bidding, optimization, and reporting.

 • Strong understanding of conversion tracking and UTMs.

 • Strong understanding of lead generation funnels.

 • Ability to analyze campaign data and recommend next steps.

 • Comfortable managing multiple client ad accounts.

 • Strong attention to detail.

 • Organized, reliable, responsive, and self-directed.

 • Able to communicate clearly about performance, issues, and recommendations.

 • Comfortable working with copywriters, designers, video editors, web developers, and CRM specialists.

 • Comfortable with spreadsheets and reporting.

 • Able to work within approved budgets and flag issues quickly.



TOOLS YOU SHOULD KNOW:

 • Meta Ads Manager.

 • Google Ads.

 • Google Analytics 4.

 • Google Tag Manager.

 • LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

 • Google Looker Studio.

 • Google Sheets.

 • TikTok Ads Manager is a plus.

 • Microsoft/Bing Ads is a plus.

 • SEMrush, SpyFu, or similar competitor research tools are a plus.

 • HubSpot or GoHighLevel for lead tracking is a plus.

 • Call tracking tools are a plus.

 • ClickUp, Asana, Notion, or similar project management tools are a plus.



NICE TO HAVE:

 • Experience working with a marketing agency.

 • Experience managing paid media for local service businesses, professional services, real estate, mortgage, legal, healthcare, home services, SaaS, B2B, technology, or growing companies.

 • Experience with YouTube Ads.

 • Experience with TikTok Ads.

 • Experience with Microsoft/Bing Ads.

 • Experience with Google Local Services Ads.

 • Experience with Performance Max.

 • Experience with call tracking.

 • Experience with landing page optimization.

 • Experience with A/B testing.

 • Experience with retargeting campaigns.

 • Experience with CRM attribution and lead quality reporting.

 • Experience with Meta Conversions API.

 • Experience with paid social creative testing.

 • Basic understanding of SEO,
 marketing, and content marketing.



ROLE BOUNDARIES:

 • Final campaign strategy and budget approval will usually come from Caliber leadership.

 • Final client communication will usually go through Caliber leadership.

 • Ad creative will usually be created by the designer or video editor, though you may provide creative direction and testing recommendations.

 • Landing page copy will usually be created by the copywriter, though you may provide conversion recommendations.

 • Landing page development will usually be handled by the web developer.

 • CRM automation will usually be handled by the CRM specialist.

 • Organic social will usually be handled by the social media manager.

 • SEO will usually be handled by the copywriter/SEO strategist.

 • Client-facing strategy calls are not expected at first.



WHAT TO EXPECT WEEKLY:

Depending on client needs, you may work on:

 • Google Ads management.

 • Meta Ads management.

 • LinkedIn Ads management when applicable.

 • Keyword research and negative keyword updates.

 • Audience targeting and retargeting updates.

 • Budget pacing checks.

 • Creative testing recommendations.

 • Campaign QA before launch.

 • Conversion tracking QA.

 • Landing page recommendations.

 • Weekly or monthly paid media reporting.

 • Ad account audits.

 • Coordination with designers, copywriters, video editors, web developers, and CRM specialists.



PAID TEST:

Finalists may be asked to complete a short paid test:

 • Review a sample ad account, campaign brief, or landing page.

 • Identify issues and opportunities.

 • Recommend a campaign structure or optimization plan.

 • Suggest 3-5 ad angles or tests.

 • Explain what metrics you would track and why.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY:

This role has strong potential to grow into more hours as Caliber expands. We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who wants to grow with us, not a one-off contractor.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please include:

 • A short introduction about your paid media and demand generation experience.

 • Examples of ad campaigns you have managed, including platforms, industries, budgets, and results if you can share them.

 • Your experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and conversion tracking.

 • Your experience with lead generation campaigns.

 • Your experience with reporting and optimization.

 • Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

 • Write “Caliber Ads” at the top of your application so we know you read this post carefully.

Sustainable Homes Melbourne was founded in 2014 with a focus on transforming Melbourne's inner-city homes into beautiful, comfortable, and sustainable places to live. We are a dedicated design-and-build firm specialising in heritage renovations, extensions, and sustainable new homes, and we have seen demand for our work grow every year since our founding.



About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Bookkeeper with strong Xero skills to join our team on a part-time, fully remote basis. This is a hands-on role that sits at the heart of our day-to-day financial operations. You will be responsible for keeping our Xero books in excellent order, reconciling invoices from our subcontractors and suppliers, and ensuring our financial reporting is clean and on time.



The ideal candidate has experience working in a residential construction or trade business, is highly proficient in Xero, and takes genuine pride in having everything reconciled correctly and delivered on time. You will report directly to the leadership team and will be trusted to manage your work with minimal supervision.



Experience & Skillset

3 or more years of experience in a bookkeeping role

Proficient in Xero: bank reconciliation, accounts payable and receivable, payroll, BAS, and reporting

Demonstrated experience reconciling subcontractor and supplier invoices in a construction, trade, or project-based environment

Strong understanding of Australian GST, BAS, PAYG, and payroll obligations

Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail

Self-managed and reliable: comfortable delivering accurately without close supervision

Strong written English communication skills

Experience with Xero Payroll and Single Touch Payroll (STP) reporting

Certificate IV in Bookkeeping, Accounting, or equivalent qualification preferred

Xero Advisor Certification is an advantage

Experience with document capture tools such as Dext is an advantage



Benefits

Fully remote role with flexible working hours

Competitive remuneration package commensurate with experience

Part-time hours: approximately 20 to 25 hours per week

Work with a dynamic and growing company doing meaningful, high-quality work

Direct access to the leadership team: no layers, no bureaucracy

A great team environment, even from a distance



Please record a short video when submitting your application answering the following questions;

What similar experience you have?

What your greatest skill is?

What is your home office setup?

What work you love doing most?

title: Real Estate Video Editor (Part or Full Time)
description:
Hello! I run a Real Estate Media business here in the states and am looking to bring our video editing in-house. There are plenty of "big box" editors out there, but since they all have giant teams you never know what you're going to get back each time. I want to bring on someone that can be a part of our team and be someone that we can work with to create a consistent look across all of our videos! We specialize in high-end videos and are among the highest quality creators in our area. I would love to find someone that can come in and is comfortable giving suggestions, keeping up with trends in the industry and can give input on where we can improve on our side of the camera as well! We are a team here and would look at you as an equal part of our crew. The ideal candidate would be comfortable with English language since communication and detail is so important in this process.



Proficiency in Final Cut Pro or Davinci Resolve is preferred. 



Looking for someone who is familiar with:

- Current real estate video editing trends (High energy edits, Studio 910/JT Visuals style edits)

- Color grading LOG footage (specifically CLog 3 right now)

- Creative transitions / masking transitions

- Higgsfield AI generation

- Familiar with premium captions/masking



We are looking to onboard someone fairly soon in preparation for the busier season coming up!



A test edit will be required with your application. Below is a link to the RAW files for a recent shoot that we did. There are opportunities for Day to Night transitions and other creative FPV shots. You don't need to put together an entire length of video (maybe just something like 30-45 seconds), as long as it is enough to show how you would color grade, music selection, sound design and most importantly how creative you can be! Have fun with it. Please include a link to the completed test edit in your application to be considered. 



Instructions for the video -

Address: 123 Main Street, Dallas, Texas

Energetic edit. Fast paced and trendy.  Color grading a priority. Okay to have deeper shadows for a more "moody" feel if it works.

At least one day to night transition



Clips at the link below! Use as many or little as you need to feel confident in what you are sending. Feel free to watermark or send a lower res version if you would be more comfortable doing so. Just trying to get a feel of your color grading/editing style using my own clips since I know what the input looks like on these.





We strive to stay on top of current trends and always be innovating and putting out the best possible product for our clients, and our video is a large part of what drives new business to us!



Looking for full time availability! I look forward to talking with you. Please let me know if you have any additional questions.
