title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant — Full-Time Remote

US Fintech Client • Big 4 / MNC Background Preferred



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

- PHP 80,000–120,000/month, commensurate with experience. Plus two bonuses each year— mid-year and year-end.

- 100% remote, forever. Work from Davao, Cebu, Baguio, the beach, the mountains —wherever you do your best work.

- No staffing tetris. You're dedicated full-time to ONE US client. No juggling five accounts, no context-switching. Real ownership, real career growth.

- 24 days of paid time off. Not to escape your job — to live your life on your terms.

- Direct mentorship from Jane Eagle (outsourced CFO, former Big 4) and real exposure to US executive teams. You'll learn at the level you want to be at, not just at the level your current role requires.

- PHP 5,000 monthly health stipend — apply it toward the HMO or insurance that fits your life.

- High bar, with us in your corner. Our client has high standards and moves fast — but you're working with us, not for them. We hire people who take pride in great work, and we make sure you have the support, structure, and advocacy to do it well.



ABOUT ME

Mom, surfer, party-lover, and teller of jokes. I help the world's biggest companies — and scrappy startups — make sense of their money as a fractional CFO (Big 4 alum, Berkeley & NYU MBA). Through Jane Eagle Consulting, I hire from a narrow pool — CPAs from top PH universities with Big 4 or large MNC experience — and place them with growing US clients. For this role, I'm the fractional CFO, so when I hire you, I'm hiring you onto a team I'm already on. If you've got high standards, want to learn from someone who's been in the seat, and still want a real life outside of work — let's talk.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior Accountant for our US-based fintech client (B2B payments technology). You'll report directly to the company's Controller and own the day-to-day accounting — AR, AP, and month-end close — for a growing, well-funded company.



This is a hands-on Senior Accountant seat, not a leadership role. You'll be in the books daily and partnering closely with the Controller, Customer Success, and engineering teams. There is real growth potential as the business scales.



The client moves fast and sets a high bar — you'll be doing real, meaningful work. The benefit of working with Jane Eagle Consulting: you have us in your corner. We mentor, advocate for you, and make sure you have what you need to succeed.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Accounts Receivable & Collections

• Generate and review monthly invoices in QuickBooks Online (QBO)

• Identify and flag discrepancies; perform month-over-month variance analysis

• Verify subscription start dates for newly onboarded merchants

• Follow up with merchants on outstanding invoices and manage collections

• Partner with Customer Success on renewals validation

• Support ad hoc reporting on revenue and collections



Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

• Review incoming vendor invoices and categorize to appropriate expense accounts

• Manage approval workflows in Ramp

• Flag and escalate material invoice amounts for review



General Bookkeeping & Month-End Close

• Maintain and execute the month-end checklist (accruals, prepaids, fixed assets)

• Record and reconcile bonus accruals, commission accruals, and payroll entries

• Perform monthly bank reconciliations

• Manage fixed asset, depreciation, and amortization schedules

• Manage the company's virtual mailbox (Earth Class Mail)



WHO YOU NEED TO BE

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Philippines

• Bachelor's degree in Accountancy from a top Philippine university (Ateneo, UP, La Salle, UST, or equivalent)

• 4-8 years of accounting experience

• Big 4 audit experience (SGV/EY, Isla Lipana/PwC, KPMG, Deloitte) OR senior accounting experience at a large US/multinational corporation

• Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) — non-negotiable for this role

• Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling)

• Solid understanding of US GAAP

• Direct experience with full-cycle month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Available during Pacific or Eastern Standard Time hours



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with subscription/SaaS revenue, recurring billing, or partner revenue share models

• Familiarity with Ramp, Salesforce/HubSpot, or Earth Class Mail

• Comfort working with AI tools (e.g., Claude) for research and workflow automation



HOW TO APPLY

We want to get to know you — not just your resume. Send us:

1. Your updated resume (PDF preferred)

2. A short written note OR a short video — whichever you prefer — telling us about your professional background (especially your Big 4 or MNC experience and your most recent hands-on QuickBooks Online work), why you want this role specifically, and one thing most people would be surprised to learn about you



Looking forward to hearing from you.

Every day you will update a structured spreadsheet that tracks 

the financial performance of my e-commerce. The sheet contains 

many formulas and many variable costs. Specifically:



- Update sales data, costs, ad spend, and other items I will 

  indicate every day

- Extract data from Shopify, Meta Ads, and Google Ads (I will 

  give you read-only access)

- Enter them correctly in the right cells and tabs of the sheet

- Verify that formulas keep working correctly after the update

- Flag anomalies, errors, or strange patterns you notice during 

  the update

- Suggest improvements to the sheet when you see opportunities 

  (more efficient formulas, clearer structure, possible 

  automations)

- Communicate via 
 for quick questions, updates, doubts



The work requires about 30 minutes per day, every day of the week.



----------------------------------------



WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO ME



This sheet is the financial heart of my business. I'm looking 

for a trusted person who manages it as if it were their own: 

absolute precision, total confidentiality, sharp eye to catch 

problems before they become big ones.



I'm not looking for someone who just enters numbers. I'm looking 

for someone who can read them and who can become, over time, a 

real partner for the operational financial management.



----------------------------------------



MY STANDARDS (please read carefully)



I DO NOT accept input errors (wrong numbers, skipped cells, 

broken formulas without flagging)



I DO NOT accept people who enter data without looking at it (if 

a cost doubles from one day to the next, I want you to tell me)



I DO NOT accept people who can't work independently



I DO NOT accept people who don't respect data confidentiality



I'm looking for someone with real attention to detail, ability 

to spot anomalies, and willingness to grow into the role



I'm a present and available client: I will do a complete 

onboarding, explain every column and formula, and I'm always 

reachable for questions



----------------------------------------



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



MUST HAVE:



- Strong knowledge of Google Sheets (formulas, lookups, 

  conditionals, pivot)

- Familiarity with basic financial concepts of an e-commerce 

  (revenue, costs, margin, ROAS, CPA)

- Experience managing complex spreadsheets with many formulas 

  and lots of data

- Obsessive attention to numerical detail

- Ability to spot anomalies and propose improvements

- Good written English (asynchronous communication via 
)

- Reliability: 30 minutes per day every day, including weekends

- Willingness to sign an NDA before starting



NICE TO HAVE:



- Background in bookkeeping, accounting, or financial analysis

- Experience with Shopify reports and analytics

- Experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads

- Knowledge of concepts like AOV, LTV, contribution margin



----------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Please send a message including:



1. The word TREASURE at the beginning

2. A short introduction about yourself (3-5 sentences)

3. A short presentation of your experience: how many years you 

   have managed spreadsheets for clients, what type of businesses 

   you have managed, and what is the most complex spreadsheet 

   you have ever managed

4. Which of these tools and platforms you know: Shopify, Meta 

   Ads, Google Ads, advanced Google Sheets

5. Logic mini-test (answer here): if today's sales are 2,500 EUR, 

   product costs are 32 percent, and today's ad spend is 800 EUR, 

   what is today's operating margin in EUR and in percentage?



I will reply to qualified candidates within 5 days with a small 

paid test before any final decision: I will give you temporary 

access to a copy of the real sheet and ask you to do a sample 

update.



Good luck!

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
MACHSHIP	Remote — Philippines	



Technical Support Specialist — Client Integrations

MachShip  ·  Full-time  ·  Day shift  ·  Work from home



:alarm_clock:  6:30 AM – 3:00 PM PH time, Mon–Fri	:zap:  APIs · JSON · FTP/SFTP	:office:  B2B SaaS · Freight tech



ABOUT THE ROLE

MachShip is an Australian cloud-based Freight Management System helping logistics businesses automate and integrate their operations. As we scale our integrations function, we’re looking for a technically capable support specialist to own the delivery and support of customer integrations — end to end.

This is not a generic helpdesk position. You’ll scope, configure, and deliver real integrations for MachShip customers, troubleshoot issues across eCommerce and ERP platforms, and provide clear technical guidance to customers building their own solutions. You’ll work directly with customers and collaborate closely with our engineering and onboarding teams — with increasing independence as you grow in the role.



WHAT WE’RE OFFERING

•	Permanent work-from-home with long-term stability

•	Day shift — 6:30 AM to 3:00 PM PH time, Monday to Friday

•	Real technical challenges with a clear growth path

•	Collaborative AU/PH team with regular check-ins and monthly 1-on-1s

•	Ownership of documentation and process improvement

•	Supported learning and professional development



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



Integration delivery

–	Triage and scope new integration enquiries — data flows, endpoints, authentication, testing

–	Configure integrations using prebuilt connectors in our integrations tool

–	Coordinate UAT, go-live, and cutover activities with customers

–	Provide post-go-live support and handle enhancements within scope	Technical support

–	Troubleshoot integration issues using Postman and browser dev tools

–	Analyse and validate JSON, XML, and CSV payloads

–	Help customers interpret API responses, auth requirements, and error patterns

–	Escalate confirmed platform defects with clear evidence and reproduction steps

Customer & stakeholder comms

–	Manage tickets in line with agreed SLAs and customer impact

–	Communicate clearly on progress, timelines, and resolutions

–	Advise customers on best practices — retries, idempotency, monitoring	Documentation & knowledge

–	Create and maintain runbooks, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides

–	Contribute to internal playbooks covering common integration patterns

–	Identify recurring issues and improve public documentation



AI-assisted work:  We actively use AI tools to support troubleshooting, log interpretation, response drafting, and documentation. You’ll be expected to use these tools to work faster and smarter — while maintaining a strong underlying technical understanding of what you’re doing.



PLATFORMS YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll regularly work across a range of eCommerce and ERP systems including:



Shopify   ·   WooCommerce   ·   BigCommerce   ·   Magento   ·   NetSuite   ·   Cin7   ·   Unleashed   ·   Neto   ·   MYOB



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

•	2+ years in a technical support, implementation, or integration delivery role — SaaS experience preferred

•	Hands-on experience with REST APIs (authentication, payloads, error handling) and FTP/SFTP

•	Comfortable reading, validating, and mapping JSON, XML, and CSV data

•	Proficient with API tools like Postman or browser dev tools

•	Familiarity with eCommerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce) or ERP systems (NetSuite, Cin7)

•	Clear, professional written English — you communicate technical issues to non-technical customers confidently

•	Strong ownership mindset — you see tickets through to resolution and follow threads until you find the root cause

•	Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience



HOW TO APPLY



1.	Submit your application via our form at 
/integrations-support (password: support). Include a cover letter that speaks to your experience with integrations, your communication approach, and why this role suits your background — we read every one.

2.	Complete a short technical assessment — shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a practical task that reflects real work in this role.

3.	Video interview — final-stage candidates will meet with our team to discuss your experience, the role, and what day-to-day life at MachShip looks like.

We are a Sydney-based legal business in the personal injury and a

mber to join our Philippines-based remote team.

About The Role

This is not an outbound sales or dialling role.



Your main responsibility will be to work through a pending list of signed-up potential clients where important information is still outstanding.



These matters cannot move forward properly until the required information has been received, reviewed, and followed up. Your role is to help move these matters from a pending list into active client files that can be allocated to the Sydney legal team.



This means you will be constantly reviewing files, identifying what is missing, following up with the right people or organisations, updating notes, and making sure matters keep progressing.



You may be required to communicate with clients, internal tea

Key Responsibilities

Your day-to-day work will include:



Reviewing pending client files and identifying outstanding information

Following up with clients and relevant third parties

Liaising with our Philippines-based team who originate the matters

Communicating daily with our Sydney-based legal team

Keeping detailed notes on every file

Updating systems clearly and accurately

Helping move matters from pending status to active legal files

Supporting Sydney-based lawyers with administrative and paralegal-style tasks

Staying organised across multiple matters at the same time

Following up consistently until the required information is received

The key measure of success in this role is your ability to reduce the pending list and keep legal matters moving forward.



Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:



Highly organised and detail-focused

A strong written and spoken English communicator

Able to work autonomously from home

A self-starter who can think on their feet

Comfortable following up regularly and professionally

Able to manage a busy workload without losing track of details

Confident speaking on the phone when required

Reliable, consistent, and process-driven

Comfortable working with lawyers, admin teams, and external parties

Able to keep excellent notes and file records

Looking for a long-term role in a structured legal business

This role requires exceptional English and communication skills. You must be able to communicate clearly with Australian-based lawyers, clients, and external organisations.



Technical Requirements

You must have:



A reliable high-speed internet connection

A quiet and professional work-from-home setup

A reliable computer

Confidence using online systems, Slack,
, and cloud-based tools

The ability to demonstrate your internet speed if requested

How The Team Works

You will work closely with our Philippines-based team and our Sydney-based legal team.



The business is managed through Slack channels, internal systems, and structured workflows. You must be comfortable working online, keeping the team updated, and maintaining clear records of your work.



This is a very important role because it helps ensure that legal matters do not sit idle and that clients can move forward through the legal process.



There is real room to grow for the right person.



Compensation And Benefits

We offer:



Attractive compensation for the role

Long-term opportunity with a stable business

Work-from-home arrangement

Supportive team environment

Clear structure, training, and systems

Two weeks paid Christmas vacation, prorated depending on start date

Paid time off over Easter

Major Australian public holidays included

Opportunity to grow within the business

This is a contractor position. You will be responsible for your own tax obligations, government contributions, healthcare, insurance, and any other personal contractor obligations in the Philippines.



Important Application Instructions

To apply, please attach:



Your updated CV

A short cover letter explaining why you are suitable for this role

In your cover letter, please include:



Your legal admin, paralegal, or administrative support experience

Your previous work history and any relevant roles

Why you are highly organised and suited to managing pending files

Why your English and communication skills are strong enough for this role

Confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time

Confirmation that you have reliable high-speed internet

Your application subject line must include: TPD Matters Admin



Applications that do not include this in the subject line, or do not attach both a CV and cover letter, will be ignored.



We are looking for people who want a serious, long-term role and who can follow simple instructions carefully.

description:

Reports To: Creative Asset Manager

Work Hours: 40 hours weekly - Flexible Time



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, and people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of graphic design and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our NEXT AI IMAGE SPECIALIST.



Role Purpose

This role is responsible for designing creative and compelling visuals for new and existing products, including illustrations, packaging, and listing images. You will also create diverse marketing materials such as social media graphics and website elements, as needed.



What Success Looks Like

Success in the Graphic Designer role means consistently delivering high-quality, on-brand visuals on time that enhance product listings and marketing campaigns. Designs require minimal revisions, follow brand standards, and effective product storytelling and conversion. Graphic designers use AI throughout the process of creating – and are continually updating their knowledge with software, techniques and output.



A successful designer continuously improves their skills, shares new techniques with the team, and collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams to strengthen the brand’s visual presence.



Primary Objectives

1. Deliver high-quality, on-brand designs for listings and marketing materials.

2. High usage of AI throughout design process.

3. Collaborate with product and marketing teams to align designs with objectives.

4. Optimize product images to meet e-commerce guidelines and boost performance.



Regular Work Activities

1. Develop effective product visuals, including listing graphics, packaging & instructions aligned with brand identity and target audience.

2. Collaborate with the product development and marketing team to ensure designs are aligned with product specifications and marketing objectives.

3. Create high-performing e-commerce listing images that meet platform guidelines and brand standards.

4. Edit and enhance product photography to support marketing and marketplace needs.

5. Perform color correction, background removal, image resizing, and other necessary edits to create polished and professional images.



Key Skills

Expertise in graphic design, illustration, and digital content creation

Strong understanding of brand identity and e-commerce platform requirements

Always updating AI knowledge to best use new software, and processes

Proficient in design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, etc.)

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Excellent photo editing skills (color correction, background removal, resizing)

Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines

Knowledge of current design trends and techniques

Self-starter who raises issues and proposes solutions before asked – a critical thinker who finds mistakes and corrects them



People Contacts and Interactions

Marketing Team – Collaborate on design concepts, campaign strategies, and promotional materials.

Amazon Operations Team – Ensure product listings and images meet Amazon’s platform guidelines and optimize performance.

Creative Asset Manager – Submit designs for review and finalize images for approval and publishing.



Role Requirements

3+ years of experience in graphic design or visual content creation

Proven experience designing for e-commerce platforms (Amazon, Shopify, etc.)

Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in product visuals and marketing collateral

Excellent communication and teamwork skills

Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment

A degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field (preferred)

title: Sage 300 Construction Accountant
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



1. Core Construction Accounting

*Maintain accurate job cost accounting across all active projects

*Prepare and manage Work-in-Progress (WIP) schedules, including revenue recognition and cost tracking

*Track retainage, committed costs, and budget vs. actual performance

*Ensure alignment between Procore (or PM systems) and Sage 300

*Support job “buyout” tracking and subcontractor financial coordination



2. Cash Flow & Financial Visibility (CRITICAL FOCUS)

*Develop and maintain cash flow projections at both company and project levels

*Provide leadership with clear, timely insight into cash position and future needs

*Assist in identifying risks related to margin erosion, cost overruns, or delayed collections

*Partner with leadership and fractional CFO/Controller to improve financial forecasting

*This directly addresses current gaps where high-level financial oversight and cash flow clarity are needed.



3. Accounts Payable & Subcontractor Management

*Manage AP workflows including vendor invoices, approvals, and payments

*Oversee subcontractor compliance (lien waivers, insurance, documentation)

*Coordinate payments tied to project funding and draw schedules

*Resolve discrepancies with vendors and internal teams



4. Month-End Close & Reporting

*Execute month-end close processes, including:

**Journal entries

**Bank and credit card reconciliations

**Job cost reconciliation

*Prepare and deliver:

**WIP reports

**Cash flow reports

**AP/AR aging

**Job profitability summaries

*Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and actionable for leadership



5. Systems & Process Improvement

*Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements in:

**Accounting workflows

**Data accuracy between systems (Sage, Procore, etc.)

*Help establish repeatable processes and reporting frameworks

*Support implementation of automation and AI tools where applicable

*Aligns with company interest in improving systems and integrating AI into operations.



6. Collaboration with Operations & Leadership

*Act as a financial partner to:

**Operations (project execution, buyouts, cost control)

**Estimating (historical cost data, accuracy)

*Support leadership in protecting margins and making informed decisions

*Participate in regular reporting cadence (weekly/monthly financial updates)



7. Team Support & Continuity

*Provide support and backup for existing accounting personnel

*Help document processes to reduce dependency on any single tea
mber

*Assist in onboarding and training additional accounting support (including offshore resources if applicable)

*Important due to current reliance on key personnel and need for redundancy.



SUCCESS METRICS (KPIs)

*Accuracy and timeliness of WIP reporting

*Visibility and reliability of cash flow forecasts

*Reduction in accounting-related project issues (billing, cost tracking, etc.)

*Improved alignment between accounting and operations

*Consistency in monthly close timelines

*Reduction in leadership intervention needed for financial clarity



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

*Active CPA license preferred.

*Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in accounting, with at least 2 years in the construction industry.

*Expertise in public accounting, specifically serving construction clients and managing multiple client accounts.

*Strong proficiency in accounting systems (e.g., Sage 300, TimberScan) is required. Experience with project management tools such as Procore is highly preferred

*Deep understanding of construction accounting standards, including WIP reporting, retainage, and cost allocation.

*Passion for delivering exceptional client service and fostering lasting client relationships.

*Excellent organizational and time-management skills to balance multiple client priorities.

*Strong leadership and team development capabilities.

*Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

*High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

*Ability to communicate complex financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Part-time

Schedule: Monday to Friday 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM CDT - Monday to Friday 9:30 PM to 1:30 AM PHT

Salary Range: Php 40,000 - Php 55,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Application Instructions

Please fill out this form:


/appqNAvkEQ10YFlc3/pagqwxmsDSuQGHrJo/form

After submitting the form, click the apply button and send us a short message on why you would be a good fit for the role.

Role Summary

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Marketing Assistant to support campaign execution, HubSpot operations, reporting, and cross-team coordination. This role is focused on improving speed of execution, managing multiple campaigns simultaneously, and ensuring consistent campaign tracking and reporting across all marketing channels.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, deadline-driven, and capable of handling rapid campaign deployment while maintaining accuracy and quality across deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

1. Campaign Setup & Execution

- Build, launch, and monitor marketing campaigns across
, blogs, landing pages, social media, and press releases

- Ensure campaigns are properly set up with correct tracking, tagging, and attribution in HubSpot

- Support campaign deployment from planning through execution

2. Rapid Campaign Deployment

- Execute time-sensitive campaigns within 24–72 hours

- Assist in launching POV campaigns including blog content,
 marketing, social media posts, and press releases

- Ensure quick turnaround without compromising quality and consistency

3. Campaign Management & Coordination

- Manage campaign calendars and scheduling to ensure deadlines are met

- Coordinate with content, design, and sales teams for campaign requirements and deliverables

- Follow up on timelines and maintain smooth workflow across departments

4. HubSpot Campaign Structuring

- Set up and manage HubSpot campaigns following proper naming conventions and asset organization

- Maintain accurate campaign tracking for reporting and attribution purposes

- Ensure all campaign assets are properly linked and monitored inside HubSpot

5. Reporting & Analytics

Prepare and monitor campaign performance reports including:

-
 performance (open rates, CTR, engagement)

- Social media engagement (impressions, clicks, interactions)

- Lead generation metrics (form submissions, contacts created)

- Funnel performance (meetings booked, pipeline contribution)

- Campaign attribution and influenced contacts

6. Continuous Optimization

- Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement

- Recommend optimizations across messaging, channels, and conversion strategies

- Support testing and adjustments to improve campaign efficiency and results

7. Basic Creative Support

- Assist in creating and editing basic marketing visuals such as social media graphics,
 banners, blog images, landing page assets, and presentation materials 

- Support quick-turnaround design needs for campaign deployment while maintaining brand consistency 

- Coordinate with the design team for larger or more complex creative requirements



Expected Outcomes

- Support faster campaign execution within 24–72 hours for rapid campaigns

- Assist in managing 6–10 concurrent campaigns effectively

- Improve campaign consistency, tracking, and reporting accuracy

- Maximize HubSpot utilization for campaign management and optimization

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field preferred

- Experience in marketing support, campaign coordination, or digital marketing is an advantage

- Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms preferred

- Strong organizational and project management skills

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to work under tight deadlines

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to multitask and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Analytical mindset with comfort in reviewing campaign data and performance metrics

- Basic skills in graphic design and image editing using tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or similar platforms 

- Ability to create simple marketing visuals while following brand guidelines and campaign objectives



Performance Success Indicators

- Timely campaign launches and execution speed

- Accuracy of HubSpot campaign setup and reporting

- Number of campaigns successfully managed in parallel

- Lead generation and campaign contribution to pipeline growth

- Process improvement and optimization recommendations

title: Inbound Sales Specialist
description:
Inbound Sales Specialist / Callback Closer, No Cold Calling



We are hiring a confident English-speaking sales rep to handle inbound callbacks from US contractors and close them into monthly trials.



This is not cold calling.



Our team leaves short voi
s for contractors. When they call back, your job is to answer live, take control of the conversation, explain our missed-call service, handle objections, and help interested contractors start a paid monthly trial.



Our service helps contractors avoid losing jobs when they miss phone calls. If they are busy on a job and cannot answer, our team answers the missed call, captures the customer’s name, number, job type, and location, then texts the job information to the contractor immediately.



This is a sales role. We are looking for someone who is friendly, confident, persuasive, and comfortable asking for the sale.



Your Responsibilities:



Answer inbound callbacks quickly

Speak confidently with US contractors and business owners

Follow a simple sales script

Ask qualification questions

Explain the missed-call service clearly

Handle basic objections

Sell the monthly trial

Send setup/payment links by SMS

Stay on the phone while the prospect opens the link when possible

Log notes in the CRM

Follow up with interested prospects

Transfer hot prospects when needed



We Are Looking For Someone Who:



Has strong spoken English

Has phone sales, appointment setting, or closing experience

Is comfortable asking prospects to take action

Can handle objections without getting nervous

Sounds calm, friendly, and confident

Can follow a script without sounding robotic

Has reliable internet and a quiet work environment

Can work US business hours

Has BPO voice, inbound sales, outbound sales, appointment setting, or customer service experience



This is a good fit if you:



You like selling

You are confident on the phone

You can stay calm when people are busy, skeptical, or confused

You can ask for payment or setup without being awkward

You like performance bonuses

You want a long-term full-time role with growth potential



This is not a good fit if you:



You are afraid to sell

You only want a customer support role

You avoid asking prospects to buy

You get nervous when people ask questions

You cannot work night shift Philippines time

You have poor internet or background noise



Pay:



$4-$6/hour depending on experience, plus performance bonuses for paid trials started.



Strong performers can earn more.



To Apply:



Please send:



Your resume

A short voice recording introducing yourself

Your sales, appointment setting, or BPO voice experience



Position starts next week full-time

title: AI Character Content Creator (Veo 3 + CapCut) — Health & Wellness Reels
description:
Looking for a full-time AI Content Creator / CapCut editor for short-form health & wellness content for Instagram Reels and
 Reels.



This role is focused on realistic AI character content, talking-character clips, and believable remedy-style health/wellness scenes.



You will be given hooks, scripts, reference videos, and creative direction. You’ll be responsible for:



1. Generating AI video clips in Google Flow / Veo 3 / Grok Imagine

2. Generating supporting AI images using tools like Nano Banana / Grok Imagine

3. Creating realistic AI characters, talking-character clips, and believable AI scenes as the main content style

4. Using ElevenLabs / HeyGen for voiceovers and talking-character videos

5. Using ChatGPT and/or Claude to refine prompts, troubleshoot generations, and improve creative direction

6. Editing everything together in CapCut with clean pacing, hook overlays, natural cuts, and 9:16 vertical exports



The goal is not flashy edits. The goal is believable, clear, emotionally engaging content that feels like real social media footage, not obvious AI.



Previous CapCut experience and AI image/video generation experience are required. Strong English comprehension and writing ability are also required because most of the work involves English hooks, scripts, prompts, and creative decisions.



You must be proficient with ChatGPT and/or Claude. You’ll use them daily, and they are core to the workflow.



Big plus if you have experience or interest in health, wellness, natural remedies, supplements, pet wellness, or emotional short-form content.

To apply, you must complete the AI Reels Editor Recreate Assignment linked below:

- Previous experience with CapCut / Instagram Reels

title: WordPress / Elementor Developer for Construction & Home Services Marketing Agency
description:
You'll be the dedicated developer maintaining and expanding 4+ WordPress sites built primarily on Elementor. Most of your work will be SEO-driven: building hyper-local landing pages, implementing schema, optimizing page speed, and turning content briefs into clean, conversion-focused pages. We move fast and use AI tools daily (Claude, ChatGPT) to amplify output — you should be comfortable doing the same.

What You'll Be Doing



Build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Elementor Pro

Understand RANKMATH!

Create hyper-local SEO landing pages from briefs (templates + variations at scale)

Implement and validate JSON-LD schema markup (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, etc.)

Optimize for Core Web Vitals and Google PageSpeed scores

Use HTML/CSS to extend Elementor when the builder hits its limits

Keep backends clean and organized (naming, structure, reusable templates — no copy-paste bloat)

QA your own work across desktop, tablet, and mobile before handoff

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to work faster without losing quality



Must-Haves



Strong hands-on Elementor + Elementor Pro experience (portfolio required)

Working knowledge of HTML and CSS inside WordPress builds

Experience implementing JSON-LD schema markup

Understanding of page speed optimization (image formats, lazy load, script management)

Clean, organized WordPress habits (plugin hygiene, backups, updates)

Strong written English and reliable async communication

Ability to QA your own work — you catch the broken mobile layout before we do



Nice-to-Have (Tell Us If You Have These)



Local SEO experience (Google Business Profile, local landing page strategy)

GoHighLevel (GHL) page builder / funnel experience

Experience with construction, home services, or trades clients

Familiarity with WP Rocket, Perfmatters, or similar performance plugins



Hours & Compensation



Full-time / Part-time 



2–4 hours overlap with Mountain Time (Edmonton) preferred

Long-term position — first 30 days are a paid trial

description:

You should have a list of backlinks you have access to and have used in the past. To ensure our brand is accurately cited and surfaced by AI-powered search engines, large language models (LLMs), and answer engines. This hybrid role bridges traditional link building with emerging disciplines including Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

Experience

2–5 years

in link building or SEO

Employment type

Full-time

Contract options available

Emerging focus

AEO + GEO

AI search & LLM citation

Core link building responsibilities

Research and prospect high-authority, niche-relevant websites for link acquisition using tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, and Moz

Execute outreach campaigns 
, LinkedIn, HARO/Connectively) to secure guest posts, editorial links, resource page placements, and digital PR coverage

Conduct competitor backlink analysis to identify gaps and replicate high-value link opportunities

Monitor the backlink profile, identify toxic links, and submit disavow requests as needed via Google Search Console

Collaborate with the content team to develop linkable assets — studies, infographics, and long-form guides that attract organic links

New discipline

AEO, GEO & LLM citation responsibilities

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

Optimizing content to be selected as the direct answer by AI assistants, voice search, and featured snippets (Google SGE, Bing Copilot, Perplexity)

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

Ensuring your brand, products, and content are accurately represented and cited in outputs from generative AI models including ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini

Audit how and whether the brand is cited in LLM outputs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and track citation frequency, accuracy, and sentiment over time

Build links and placements on sources that LLMs and AI answer engines heavily index — authoritative publications, Wikipedia, industry wikis, Reddit, Quora, and government/educational domains

Work with the content team to structure pages using FAQ schema, speakable schema, and clear entity definitions that improve parsability by AI systems

Develop and execute digital PR strategies specifically aimed at earning mentions on high-E-E-A-T domains that serve as training and retrieval sources for AI models

Optimize brand Knowledge Panel, Wikidata entries, and third-party review platforms (G2, Trustpilot, Clutch) to strengthen entity recognition across AI systems

title: Content Writer
description:
About Fusion Vine

Fusion Vine is a remote-first company focused on building efficient, scalable systems that help businesses grow through smart operations, content, and digital execution. We specialize in combining human talent with AI-powered workflows to deliver high-quality results at scale.



Our team values clarity, accountability, continuous improvement, and performance-based growth. We work with clear processes, defined expectations, and a strong focus on outcomes.



Role Overview

Fusion Vine is hiring a Content Specialist to help scale content production through AI-assisted workflows. This role is ideal for motivated writers who can combine strong English skills with critical thinking and smart use of AI tools. Entry-level candidates are welcome: if you can think critically and move fast, we can work with you.



Key Goal

Produce high-quality, accurate, and well-structured content at speed: using AI as a tool, not a shortcut: while maintaining clarity, brand voice, and defined quality standards.



Responsibilities

Write and deliver content using AI models as a writing aid, not a replacement for judgment

Critically review and refine AI-generated drafts for readability, accuracy, tone, and structure

Fact-check content and ensure it meets quality standards before submission

Follow content briefs, SOPs, and style guidelines closely

Complete assigned article bundles within agreed timelines

Edit for grammar, readability, and proper formatting

Stay productive and proactive: do not wait to be pushed into tasks



Requirements

Strong English proficiency: written and reading comprehension

Ability to think critically and improve AI-generated content rather than copy it blindly

Self-motivated with a strong sense of urgency and follow-through

Reliable internet connection and a suitable work device

Ability to follow instructions, briefs, and feedback closely

Critical thinking and troubleshooting is essential

Comfortable using AI tools for content creation and editing

Entry-level candidates accepted: hustle and critical thinking matter more than years of experience



Nice to Have

Foundational knowledge or genuine interest in the topics being covered

Experience with SEO content writing

Familiarity with content management systems

Background in marketing, blogs, or long-form content

Prior experience working in a remote or freelance setting



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Speed of delivery: complete article bundles quickly and on schedule (e.g., 15 articles in 2 days, not 2 weeks)

Quality of output: submit polished, reviewed content that meets defined completion criteria

Critical thinking: demonstrate genuine review and refinement of AI outputs, not blind copy-paste

Responsiveness: jump into assigned projects immediately without delay

Consistency: maintain steady, reliable output throughout the trial period and beyond



Compensation

$3.50 – $5.00 per hour (we have 1 month trial worth of $3/hour, converting it to $5/hour after 1 month)

Rate determined based on experience, skills, and performance during the trial period

Piecework/bundle-based structure: payment upon completion of each assigned bundle

One-month trial period to assess fit and performance

Opportunity to increase rate and expand hours after a successful trial



Why Join Fusion Vine?

Fully remote work environment

Clear systems, expectations, and feedback from day one

Performance-based growth: your results determine your opportunities

Hands-on experience with AI-powered content workflows

Opportunity for long-term partnership if the trial goes well

Entry-level friendly: we value drive and quality output over credentials

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator & Calendar Manager  Executive Assistant Role
description:
This is a full-time role requiring 50 hours per week.



Because real estate does not always happen strictly between 9:00 and 5:00, this person must be flexible and willing to help after hours when the situation calls for it. This does not mean they are expected to be available 24/7, but they do need to understand that urgent deadlines, client needs, showings, open houses, and transaction issues may require attention outside normal business hours.



Expected Availability

50 hours per week

Available during normal business hours

Potential after-hours availability depending on the situation

Able to respond quickly when urgent real estate matters come up

Flexible with evenings or weekends when needed for showings, open houses, deadlines, or closings

Dependable and organized even when the schedule changes quickly

Calendar, Showings & Open House Scheduling



This person will be responsible for helping manage and coordinate the agent’s schedule, including:



Scheduling client meetings

Scheduling buyer showings

Scheduling listing appointments

Scheduling inspections

Scheduling appraisals

Scheduling open houses

Coordinating with sellers, buyers, other agents, lenders, title companies, inspectors, photographers, and vendors

Making sure appointments are added to the calendar correctly

Sending reminders for important appointments and deadlines

Keeping the agent updated on where they need to be and what is coming next

Helping make sure open houses and showings are planned, confirmed, and communicated clearly

title: Zoho Recruit Implementer & Ecosystem Builder
description:
About the role:

We're looking for a skilled Zoho developer to build and configure our tech stack from the ground up. This is a hands-on build role — you'll implement Zoho Recruit as our core ATS and connect it with the broader Zoho ecosystem to support how our team operates day to day.



Crucially, you need to understand how recruitment actually works — the workflows, candidate pipelines, client management, and placement processes — so you can translate that into smart, practical Zoho configurations. We don't need someone who will learn on the job; we need someone who has done this before.



What you'll build

- Full Zoho Recruit setup — job pipelines, candidate stages, interview scheduling, offer workflows, and automation rules

- Client (employer) management integrated with Zoho CRM — job briefs, contacts, and placement tracking

- Zoho Flow automations connecting Recruit, CRM, People, Mail, and Sign where relevant

- Custom modules, fields, and layouts tailored to how a recruitment operation works

- Career portal setup and job board integrations

- Reporting dashboards to track placements, pipeline health, and consultant activity

- Clean documentation and handover so the internal team can manage and extend the system



What we need from you

- Proven experience implementing Zoho Recruit — ideally within a staffing or recruitment business

- Strong working knowledge of the Zoho ecosystem: CRM, Flow, People, Sign, Mail, and how they connect

- A genuine understanding of recruitment workflows — sourcing, screening, placement, and client management — so configs make operational sense

- Ability to scope, plan, and deliver a full system build within a fixed project timeline

- Clear communication and documentation — remote collaboration throughout



Nice to have

- Deluge scripting experience for custom functions and advanced automation

- Previous builds for temp, perm, or executive search businesses

- Experience migrating data into Zoho Recruit from another ATS

title: Sales Representative Open position- Florida USA
description:
Job Description



We are a local home service company based in South Florida, specializing in air conditioning services and HVAC solutions for residential customers.



We are looking for a strong salesperson to join our team and help us handle incoming leads, follow up with customers, send estimates, and schedule appointments for our HVAC technicians.



This position is for someone who knows how to sell. HVAC experience is not required — we will train you on the product, pricing, platforms, and process. The most important skill is sales ability.



Responsibilities

Call, text, and follow up with incoming leads

Communicate professionally with American customers

Understand customer needs and present the right HVAC solution

Send estimates using our existing system and templates

Schedule appointments for HVAC technicians to visit customers’ homes

Manage leads and tasks inside Go High Level

Follow up consistently until the lead is closed, scheduled, or no longer interested

Use our internal tools, AI support, and CRM to stay organized

Work with high-ticket air conditioning services, typically ranging from $5,000 to $7,000

Requirements

Strong sales skills

Excellent English communication

Comfortable speaking with customers by phone and message

Experience selling to the American market is a strong plus

Organized, proactive, and consistent with follow-up

Turn new and old leads into **showed** appointments on our calendar.



You will:  

- Respond to new leads *within minutes*

Success Metrics (Your Scorecard)  

- Average response time to new leads  

- Number of outbound calls & texts per day  

- Appointments booked per day / week  

- Show-up rate for booked appointments  

- Re-activated / rebooked past leads



Requirements

- Experience in any of the following is a plus:

Compensation & Benefits  

- Competitive monthly salary (in USD, paid via Wise)

- Performance bonuses tied to appointments *set and showed*

 with the subject:

description:
About Us

Deryan Financial Group is a family-owned accounting and finance firm with over 40 years of experience helping clients make smarter financial and lending decisions.

We combine the expertise of mortgage broking and accounting to deliver end-to-end solutions — from securing the right loan to optimising tax and business outcomes.



The Opportunity

If you’re an experienced Bookkeeper who takes pride in accuracy, organisation, and compliance — this is your opportunity to take ownership of client books and lead the payroll function within our growing accounting division.



You’ll manage day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple clients, ensure payrolls are processed correctly and on time, and maintain compliance with current Fair Work and ATO requirements. You’ll work closely with our accountants, keeping client files accurate and complete so the tax team can focus on advisory and strategy.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives on structure and precision, and is confident in managing payroll and bookkeeping from end to end.



What You’ll Do

Manage bookkeeping for a portfolio of business clients across multiple industries.



Payroll processing, ensuring accuracy in pay runs, superannuation, PAYG, and leave entitlements.



Prepare and lodge BAS, IAS, STP, and superannuation contributions.



Perform bank reconciliations, transaction allocations, and maintain accurate financial records.



Communicate directly with clients regarding payroll changes, compliance issues, and outstanding queries.



Collaborate with the tax team to finalise year-end accounts and reports.



Identify and implement process improvements to streamline bookkeeping and payroll systems.



About You

3+ years’ experience in bookkeeping, payroll, or client accounting (essential).



Proven experience with Xero Payroll and related add-ons (e.g. Deputy, Employment Hero, KeyPay).



Experience with all compliance lodgements for the Australian Taxation System including BAS and IAS



Experience with all superannuation reporting including exposure to multiple clearing houses.



Experience with Payroll tax for reconciliation of Payroll, Preparation and submission of payroll tax returns.



Confident interpreting awards and ensuring compliance with Fair Work standards.



Experience with the uploading of AR and AP including manual and auto integration of data from multiple software packages including Restoke/ Hubdoc etc.



Excellent attention to detail and time management skills.



Professional communication skills and ability to manage client relationships independently.



Organized, reliable, and proactive in identifying issues before they arise.



What’s on Offer



Competitive salary based on experience.



Supportive, professional, and family-oriented team culture.



Opportunity to lead the bookkeeping and payroll function within the firm.



Exposure to a wide range of clients, industries, and accounting systems.



How to Apply



Submit your resume and a brief statement of interest to [wendy@deryan.com.au

] with the subject line: Bookkeeper/Payroll – [Your Name].

title: Experienced Brand Manager Assistant to support 12+ Amazon brands for growth, execution, drive performance and operation
description:

We're hiring a Brand Manager Assistant who will work directly under the Senior Brand Manager to execute day-to-day brand operations. This is a hands-on role focused on the “legwork” that drives performance: optimizing listings, managing keyword research, coordinating creative projects, and pulling actionable data.



If the Senior Brand Manager sets the playbook, the Associate Brand Manager runs the plays — ensuring everything gets executed on time, correctly, and at a high level.



Key Responsibilities

1. Listing Management & Optimization

Create, update, and fully optimize Amazon product listings (titles, bullets, descriptions, images, videos, A+ content).

Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to improve rankings and visibility.

Ensure all listings remain Rufus and Cosmos compliant with Amazon’s latest requirements.

Test content variations (A/B testing) to improve CTR and conversions.



2. Data Research & Analysis

Pull performance data from Amazon Seller Central and external tools (Data Dive, Helium 10, Jungle Scout).

Identify trends, keyword shifts, and competitor activity.

Provide actionable recommendations to the Senior Brand Manager to improve conversions, CTR, and sales velocity.



3. Cross-Team Collaboration

Work closely with the graphic design team to request, coordinate, and deliver images, infographics, and A+ creatives.

Partner with the marketing team to support product launches, promotions, and review-generation initiatives.

Ensure all projects are aligned with deadlines, strategy, and brand guidelines.



4. Conversion-Focused Execution

Continuously update and refine listings to improve conversion rates and customer engagement.

Maintain Amazon Brand Stores, A+ content, and ad creatives for consistency and performance.

Assist in preparing assets for influencer campaigns and external marketing pushes.



5. Project & Compliance Support

Own the administrative “heavy lifting” of flat files, bulk uploads, and catalog troubleshooting.

Flag compliance issues, unauthorized sellers, or listing errors for quick resolution.

Support market expansion efforts by preparing research and draft listings for new product opportunities.



Skills & Qualifications



2+ years experience in Amazon FBA operations, brand management, or digital marketing.

Proficient in Amazon Seller Central, flat files, listing creation, and troubleshooting.

Strong skills in SEO, keyword research, and listing optimization.

Data-driven mindset; confident in Google Sheets and reporting.

Strong communication skills to work cross-functionally with design, marketing, and operations teams.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple deadlines.



What Success Looks Like

Every listing across assigned brands is fully optimized, compliant, and performing.

Senior Brand Manager receives clear, accurate reports and recommendations.

Creative assets are delivered on time because you coordinated smoothly with design.



Product launches happen seamlessly with marketing and review strategies in place.

Conversions and rankings consistently improve due to your execution. If you feel you are the right fit, please respond to the job with the title " The Best Supporting Branding Manager Out There!"

----------

Tam Ma

Co Founder

Prodigy Media

title: Marketing and Sales Graphic Designer
description:
Caliber is a U.S.-based marketing and growth firm serving local service businesses, professional services companies, B2B brands, and growing companies across multiple industries. We are looking for a versatile Marketing Graphic Designer to join our growing team on a part-time basis, with the potential to grow into a larger role over time.



This is not just a basic Canva social media role. We need someone who can create polished, professional marketing assets across social media, sales collateral, brand materials, ads, blog graphics, decks, and web design support.



You should be able to work from creative briefs, follow brand guidelines, organize design files, and collaborate with copywriters, social media managers, video editors, web developers, and marketing strategists.

SOCIAL DESIGN & DIGITAL DESIGN

 • Static social media graphics.

 graphics.

 • Google, Meta, and LinkedIn ad creative.

 • Display ad layouts.

 • Proposal templates.

 • Sales deck slides.

 • Client-facing report layouts.

 • Brochure design.

 • Media kit design.

 • White paper design and layout when needed.

 • Trade show and event materials when needed.

 • Leave-behinds and handouts.



BRAND & IDENTITY SUPPORT

 • Brand style guide creation and maintenance.

 • Logo variation layouts and usage guidelines.

 • Color palette documentation.

 • Typography documentation.

 • Icon and illustration sets.

 • Branded templates for social, decks, PDFs, and reports.

 • Brand asset libraries organized by client.

 • Business card and basic print collateral design.

 • Letterhead and document templates.

 • Visual identity cleanup and consistency across client assets.



CONTENT SUPPORT

 • Blog header graphics.

 • In-post blog graphics.

 • Infographics.

 • Newsletter header graphics.

 •
 graphics.

 • Content upgrade graphics such as lead magnets, guides, and checklists.

 • Podcast cover art when needed.

 • Webinar and event promotional graphics.

 • Graphics based on quotes, stats, key points, and insights from written content.



VIDEO DESIGN SUPPORT

 • Thumbnail graphics for videos.

 • Title cards.

 • Lower-third templates.

 • Intro and outro graphics.

 • Branded video frames.

 • Caption style references.

 • Motion graphic assets for the video editor when needed.

 • Social video cover images.



WEB DESIGN SUPPORT

 • Website section mockups.

 • Landing page design support.

 • Figma layouts for web pages.

 • Hero graphics.

 • CTA section designs.

 • Icons and graphics for websites.

 • Visual direction and asset handoff for web developers.

 • Web-optimized images and graphics.

 • Collaboration with web developers on layout, hierarchy, and responsive design references.



FILE & ASSET MANAGEMENT

 • Maintain organized client design folders.

 • Keep brand asset libraries up to date.

 • Export assets in the correct sizes for each platform.

 • Export files in the correct formats, including web-optimized PNG/JPG, editable Canva/Figma files, slide decks, and print-ready PDFs when needed.

 • Maintain version control on major design files.

 • Deliver editable source files when requested.

 • Follow naming conventions and keep project files organized.



COLLABORATION

 • Work from creative briefs provided by the copywriter, social media manager, strategist, or client lead.

 • Collaborate with copywriters to turn written content into visual assets.

 • Collaborate with social media managers on post graphics, carousels, and campaign visuals.

 • Collaborate with video editors by providing thumbnails, lower thirds, branded frames, intro/outro graphics, and visual assets.

 • Collaborate with web designers/developers on website graphics, page layouts, and visual direction.

 • Take feedback and revise designs quickly and professionally.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

 • Strong portfolio with marketing design examples.

 • Ability to design for multiple industries and visual styles.

 • Strong sense of layout, typography, spacing, hierarchy, and brand consistency.

 • Experience designing social graphics, carousels, sales collateral, decks, and PDFs.

 • Ability to make dense business copy look clean, organized, and professional.

 • Comfortable working in Canva and Figma.

 • Experience with Adobe tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or InDesign.

 • Comfortable designing for both digital and print formats.

 • Strong attention to detail.

 • Organized, reliable, responsive, and self-directed.

 • Able to work across multiple client brands at once.

 • Able to follow brand guidelines while still bringing creative ideas.

 • Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions.

 • Good written English for communication, project updates, and design notes.



TOOLS YOU SHOULD KNOW:

 • Canva.

 • Figma.

 • Adobe Photoshop.

 • Adobe Illustrator.

 • Google Slides.

 • PowerPoint.



NICE TO HAVE:

 • Adobe InDesign experience.

 • Experience working with a marketing agency.

 • Experience designing for local service businesses, professional services, real estate, mortgage, legal, healthcare, home services, SaaS, B2B, or technology companies.

 • Experience creating brand guidelines.

 • Experience designing sales collateral, pitch decks, case studies, white papers, and one-pagers.

 • Experience creating paid ad graphics.

 • Experience designing web layouts or landing page mockups.

 • Familiarity with Webflow, Framer, Wix, or WordPress.

 • Basic video design support experience, such as thumbnails, title cards, lower thirds, and branded frames.



WHAT THIS ROLE WILL COLLABORATE ON:

 • Copywriters will usually provide the copy, messaging, and creative brief.

 • Social media managers will usually handle posting and scheduling.

 • Video editors will handle video editing, but you may provide supporting design assets.

 • Web developers will handle website implementation, but you may provide layouts, graphics, and design direction.

 • Caliber leadership will provide campaign strategy and final approvals.



WHAT THIS ROLE WILL NOT OWN AT FIRST:

 • Final campaign strategy.

 • Copywriting or content strategy.

 • Social media publishing or scheduling.

 • Full video editing.

 • Website development or coding.

 • Client-facing strategy calls.



WHAT TO EXPECT WEEKLY:

Depending on client needs, you may work on:

 • Social media graphics.

 • LinkedIn carousels.

 • Blog graphics.

 • Ad graphics.

 • One-pagers or two-pagers.

 • Sales collateral.

 • Deck slides.

 • Case study layouts.

 • Website graphics.

 • Brand guideline updates.

 • Thumbnails or video support graphics.

 • File exports and asset organization.

 • Revisions based on feedback.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY:

This role has strong potential to grow into more hours as Caliber expands. We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who wants to grow with us, not a one-off freelancer.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please include:

 • A short introduction about your graphic design and marketing design experience.

 • A link to your portfolio.

 • Examples of social graphics, carousels, sales collateral, decks, PDFs, brand guidelines, or ad graphics you have designed.

 • The design tools you use regularly.

 • Your experience with Canva, Figma, and Adobe tools.

 • Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

 • Write “Caliber Design” at the top of your application so we know you read this post carefully.

description:
Caliber is a U.S.-based marketing and growth firm serving local service businesses, B2B companies, and professional services clients. We are looking for an organized, detail-oriented Social Media Manager to join our team on a part-time basis, with strong potential to grow into a larger role over time.



This is not just a scheduling role. We need someone who can manage content calendars, coordinate with our creative team, format and publish content across multiple platforms, monitor engagement, and track performance across multiple client accounts simultaneously.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN:



CONTENT CALENDAR & PLANNING

 • Building and maintaining monthly content calendars per client submitted for approval.

 • Mapping content to campaigns, launches, promotions, and client goals.

 • Balancing content mix across educational, promotional, social proof, engagement, and behind-the-scenes posts.

 • Planning content around holidays, industry events, and relevant 
nts.

 • Coordinating publish timing across platforms for reach and consistency.



PUBLISHING & SCHEDULING

 • Scheduling and publishing posts across LinkedIn, Instagram,
, TikTok, X, and YouTube.

 • Ensuring correct image sizes, video specs, character limits, and formatting per platform.

 • Quality checking every post before it goes live, including links, tags, formatting, captions, and spelling.

 • Managing posting frequency per platform and per client.

 • Story and reel scheduling.

 • Pinned post management.

 • Link-in-bio management using Linktree, Beacons, or similar tools.



PLATFORM MANAGEMENT

 • Setting up and maintaining social profiles across platforms.

 • Profile optimization, including bios, headers, profile photos, highlights, and links.

 • Hashtag research and strategy per platform and per client.

 • YouTube video descriptions and tags when applicable.

 • Platform-specific formatting, including understanding what works differently on LinkedIn vs. Instagram vs. TikTok vs.
.



CAPTION POLISHING & POST SEQUENCING

 • Polishing captions provided by the copywriter for each platform’s tone and format.

 • Adapting long-form copy into platform-native short-form posts.

 • Sequencing posts strategically across a monthly calendar.

 • Ensuring CTAs are clear and consistent.



ENGAGEMENT & COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT

 • Monitoring comments and DMs across client accounts when requested.

 • Responding to comments and engaging with followers when approved.

 • Flagging important messages, leads, or reputation issues immediately.

 • Liking and engaging with relevant accounts and industry content when approved.

 • Monitoring brand mentions.



REPORTING & ANALYTICS

 • Weekly or monthly social media performance reports per client.

 • Tracking follower growth, reach, impressions, engagement rate, and clicks.

 • Identifying top-performing posts and content types.

 • Recommending content adjustments based on performance data.

 • Using platform-native analytics and third-party reporting tools.



STRATEGY SUPPORT

 • Identifying trending topics, sounds, and formats relevant to each client.

 • Monitoring competitor social media accounts, including what they are posting and what appears to be performing.

 • Recommending new content angles based on what is working.

 • Suggesting platform expansions when appropriate.

 • Testing posting times and content formats.



TEAM COORDINATION

 • Working from creative briefs and captions provided by the copywriter.

 • Requesting graphics from the designer with clear specs, sizes, and deadlines.

 • Requesting video edits from the video editor with platform-specific specs.

 • Coordinating asset delivery to ensure nothing is late to publish.

 • Communicating the publishing schedule clearly to the team.

 • Tracking all published posts in a shared log.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

 • Hands-on experience managing social media accounts across multiple platforms.

 • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

 • Strong understanding of platform-specific formatting, specs, and best practices.

 • Organized and detail-oriented.

 • Comfortable with social media scheduling tools such as Buffer, Later, Hootsuite, Metricool, or Publer.

 • Comfortable with Canva for minor graphic edits when needed.

 • Familiar with platform-native analytics and basic reporting.

 • Responsive, reliable, and proactive.

 • Strong written English for caption polishing, responses, and internal communication.



TOOLS YOU SHOULD KNOW:

 • Scheduling tools such as Buffer, Later, Hootsuite, Metricool, or Publer.

 • Canva for quick edits.

 • Native platform analytics.

 • Google Analytics.

 • Linktree or Beacons.

 • ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Trello, or similar project management tools.

 • Google Sheets or spreadsheets for calendar and post tracking.



NICE TO HAVE:

 • Experience working inside a marketing agency.

 • Experience managing social media for local service businesses, professional services, B2B companies, real estate, legal, healthcare, or home services.

 • Experience with TikTok and YouTube specifically.

 • Familiarity with paid social media ads, especially Meta and LinkedIn.

 • Basic video editing in CapCut or similar for quick social edits.



ROLE BOUNDARIES:

 • Long-form copywriting will usually come from the copywriter.

 • Graphic design beyond basic Canva edits will usually be handled by the designer.

 • Video editing will usually be handled by the video editor.

 • Paid social media ad management will usually be handled separately.

 • Client-facing strategy calls will usually go through Caliber leadership.



WHAT TO EXPECT WEEKLY:

Depending on client needs, you may work on:

 • Content calendar updates and scheduling.

 • Publishing and QA across client platforms.

 • Engagement monitoring and community responses.

 • Asset coordination with the designer and video editor.

 • Performance reporting and analytics review.

 • Hashtag and trend research.

 • Caption polishing and post sequencing.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY:

This role has strong potential to grow into more hours or a full-time position as our client base expands. We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who wants to grow with us, not a one-off contractor.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please include:

 • A short introduction about your social media management experience.

 • Examples of accounts you have managed, including platforms, industries, and results if possible.

 • The scheduling and analytics tools you use regularly.

 • Your experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

 • Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

 • Write “Caliber Social” at the top of your application so we know you read this post carefully.

title: AI-Native Content Producer — Wedding Tech (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
AI-Native Content Producer — Wedding Tech (Remote, Full-Time)

$300 AUD test month ? uncapped earnings with incentives + affiliate

I'm building a wedding tech product and I need someone full-time to run content production at high volume. Real opportunity, real growth, real money if you can perform.

Before you read further, study these. If you haven't watched all of them, don't apply:















The Higgsfield reels show you the workflow you'll be running every day — Claude does the prompting, Higgsfield generates, you direct the output. 
 account shows you what's already out there in the wedding space. Your job is to do better than that. Higher volume, sharper edits, smarter hooks.



The work:



You'll be producing a high daily volume of reels and carousels using Claude + Higgsfield + Canva. AI generates fast — there's no reason to be capped at a handful of videos a day when the tools can output dozens per hour. You'll be running multiple accounts across TikTok and Instagram, scheduling and uploading, monitoring what wins, and doubling down on whatever the algorithm rewards. You'll be feeding Claude trending references each morning and letting it write the prompts. Your job is taste, quality control, edit polish, and distribution at scale.



You need to:



Already use Claude daily for your own work (Projects, MCPs, prompting)

Be willing to learn Higgsfield in week one — research it before you apply

Be fast in Canva

Have strong taste — you can tell instantly which version of a video will pop

Have reliable internet and your own setup

Live on TikTok and Instagram and know what's trending this week



Pay structure:



Month 1: $300 AUD flat (test month — prove you can deliver)

Month 2 onwards: base goes up + performance incentives per piece and per account growth

Affiliate cut on conversions driven by your content — top performers can earn well above standard rates

Full-time, long-term role with real upside



How to apply — read carefully:

Don't send a CV. Don't tell me about your hobbies. Don't pitch me.

Pick any wedding brand that already exists (Wedibox, Joy, Zola, Minted, can be any. Using Claude + Higgsfield + Canva, produce two reels and two carousels for that brand in the style shown in the Higgsfield reels above. Make them realistic, well-edited, and good enough that they could actually post tomorrow.



Send me:



The five files

A link to the Claude conversation you used to generate them

One sentence on which one you think is your best and why



I'll review the best submissions. Top performers get hired. Whoever produces the most polished, realistic work gets the role and the long-term opportunity.

title: CRM & Email Marketing

 campaigns and automations that turn existing relationships into repeatable pipeline.

The ideal candidate is a high-ownership, process-driven professional who thrives in a build-from-scratch environment. This is a role for someone who cares about what works, builds things that last, and is comfortable creating systems and processes where none have existed before.

Qualifications:

*5+ years in
 marketing or CRM administration — B2B experience strongly preferred.

*Solid
 marketing fundamentals — deliverability, segmentation, automation, personalization, and A/B testing.

 and CRM is a plus.

-Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

-WFH set-up

-Opportunities for career advancement.

-HMO coverage for employee and immediate family members.



Join our team now and be part of the top 1% talent in the Philippines!

title: Web Designer & Developer for Webflow, Framer, Wix, WordPress
description:
Caliber is a U.S.-based marketing and growth firm serving local service businesses, B2B companies, and professional services clients. We are looking for a skilled Web Designer & No-Code Developer to join our team on a part-time basis, with strong potential to grow into a larger role over time.



This is not just a website editing role. We need someone who can take approved copy, design direction, and client goals and turn them into clean, functional, responsive web pages across multiple platforms and multiple client accounts.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN:



WEBSITE PLATFORMS

 • Webflow builds, edits, and CMS management.

 • Framer builds and edits.

 • Wix builds and edits.

 • WordPress edits, plugin management, and theme updates.

 • Elementor and WPBakery edits when applicable.

 • Landing page builders when needed.

 • CMS updates and blog/page publishing support.



LANDING PAGES

 • Building landing pages from copy and design briefs.

 • Campaign landing pages, lead-gen pages, service pages, demo pages, contact pages, and thank-you pages.

 • Updating page sections, CTAs, forms, layout, and flow.

 • Building simple A/B test variants when needed.



WEBSITE EDITS

 • Text updates, image swaps, CTA updates, navigation edits, and footer edits.

 • Adding testimonials, case studies, logos, and team pages.

 • Updating service pages and fixing spacing or layout issues.

 • Cleaning up mobile issues and formatting inconsistencies.

 • Blog publishing and formatting support.

 • Cross-browser testing across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge when needed.

 • Testing form behavior, button links, navigation, sticky headers, image scaling, section spacing, text wrapping, mobile CTAs, and page load appearance.

 • Running a full QA checklist before every launch and after every major update.



FORMS & EMBEDS

, Typeform, Jotform, and contact forms.

 • CRM form connections and thank-you page redirects.

 • Hidden fields and UTM capture support.

 • Form testing, including confirmation messages,
 notifications, and lead routing.

 • Embedding videos, maps, reviews, social feeds, chat widgets, and pop-ups.

 • Calendar and booking link embeds.



BASIC HTML, CSS & CUSTOM CODE

 • Button and form styling.

 • Layout tweaks and spacing fixes.

 • Responsive adjustments.

 • Simple animations and interactions.

 • Script embeds and tracking code placement.



ANALYTICS & TRACKING

 • Installing and QA-ing Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, Google Ads conversion tags, HubSpot tracking code, and GHL tracking scripts.

 • UTM capture support.



TECHNICAL SEO BASICS
